19063.label: Jeremiah 1:1
19063.text: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hil·kiʹah, one of the priests that were in Anʹa·thoth in the land of Benjamin;

19064.label: Jeremiah 1:2
19064.text: to whom the word of Jehovah occurred in the days of Jo·siʹah the son of Aʹmon, the king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reigning.

19065.label: Jeremiah 1:3
19065.text: And it kept on occurring in the days of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, until the completion of the eleventh year of Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, until Jerusalem went into exile in the fifth month.

19066.label: Jeremiah 1:4
19066.text: And the word of Jehovah began to occur to me, saying:

19067.label: Jeremiah 1:5
19067.text: “Before I was forming you in the belly I knew you, and before you proceeded to come forth from the womb I sanctified you. Prophet to the nations I made you.”

19068.label: Jeremiah 1:6
19068.text: But I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Here I actually do not know how to speak, for I am but a boy.”

19069.label: Jeremiah 1:7
19069.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Do not say, ‘I am but a boy.’ But to all those to whom I shall send you, you should go; and everything that I shall command you, you should speak.

19070.label: Jeremiah 1:8
19070.text: Do not be afraid because of their faces, for ‘I am with you to deliver you,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19071.label: Jeremiah 1:9
19071.text: At that Jehovah thrust his hand out and caused it to touch my mouth. Then Jehovah said to me: “Here I have put my words in your mouth.

19072.label: Jeremiah 1:10
19072.text: See, I have commissioned you this day to be over the nations and over the kingdoms, in order to uproot and to pull down and to destroy and to tear down, to build and to plant.”

19073.label: Jeremiah 1:11
19073.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying: “What are you seeing, Jeremiah?” So I said: “An offshoot of an almond tree is what I am seeing.”

19074.label: Jeremiah 1:12
19074.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “You have seen well, for I am keeping awake concerning my word in order to carry it out.”

19075.label: Jeremiah 1:13
19075.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to me the second time, saying: “What are you seeing?” So I said: “A widemouthed cooking pot blown upon is what I am seeing, and its mouth is away from the north.”

19076.label: Jeremiah 1:14
19076.text: At this Jehovah said to me: “Out of the north the calamity will be loosened against all the inhabitants of the land.

19077.label: Jeremiah 1:15
19077.text: For ‘here I am calling for all the families of the kingdoms of the north,’ is the utterance of Jehovah; ‘and they will certainly come and place each one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all her walls round about and against all the cities of Judah.

19078.label: Jeremiah 1:16
19078.text: And I will speak with them my judgments over all their badness, in that they have left me and they keep making sacrificial smoke to other gods and bowing down to the works of their own hands.’

19079.label: Jeremiah 1:17
19079.text: “And as for you, you should gird up your hips, and you must rise up and speak to them everything that I myself command you. Do not be struck with any terror because of them, in order that I may not strike you with terror before them.

19080.label: Jeremiah 1:18
19080.text: But as for me, here I have made you today a fortified city and an iron pillar and copper walls against all the land, toward the kings of Judah, toward her princes, toward her priests and toward the people of the land.

19081.label: Jeremiah 1:19
19081.text: And they will be certain to fight against you, but they will not prevail against you, for ‘I am with you,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘to deliver you.’”

19082.label: Jeremiah 2:1
19082.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to me, saying:

19083.label: Jeremiah 2:2
19083.text: “Go, and you must call out in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “I well remember, on your part, the loving-kindness of your youth, the love during your being engaged to marry, your walking after me in the wilderness, in a land not sown with seed.

19084.label: Jeremiah 2:3
19084.text: Israel was something holy to Jehovah, the first yield to Him.”’ ‘Any persons devouring him would make themselves guilty. Calamity itself would come upon them,’ was the utterance of Jehovah.”

19085.label: Jeremiah 2:4
19085.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, O house of Jacob, and all YOU families of the house of Israel.

19086.label: Jeremiah 2:5
19086.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “What have YOUR fathers found in me that was unjust, so that they have become far off from me, and they kept walking after the vain idol and becoming vain themselves?

19087.label: Jeremiah 2:6
19087.text: And they have not said, ‘Where is Jehovah, the One bringing us up out of the land of Egypt, the One walking us through the wilderness, through a land of desert plain and pit, through a land of no water and of deep shadow, through a land through which no man passed and in which no earthling man dwelt?’

19088.label: Jeremiah 2:7
19088.text: “And I gradually brought YOU to a land of the orchard, to eat its fruitage and its good things. But YOU came in and defiled my land; and my own inheritance YOU made something detestable.

19089.label: Jeremiah 2:8
19089.text: The priests themselves did not say, ‘Where is Jehovah?’ And the very ones handling the law did not know me; and the shepherds themselves transgressed against me, and even the prophets prophesied by Baʹal, and after those who could bring no benefit they walked.

19090.label: Jeremiah 2:9
19090.text: “‘Therefore I shall contend further with YOU people,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and with the sons of YOUR sons I shall contend.’

19091.label: Jeremiah 2:10
19091.text: “‘But pass over to the coastlands of the Kitʹtim and see. Yes, send even to Keʹdar and give YOUR special consideration, and see whether anything like this has happened.

19092.label: Jeremiah 2:11
19092.text: Has a nation exchanged gods, even for those that are no gods? But my own people have exchanged my glory for what can bring no benefit.

19093.label: Jeremiah 2:12
19093.text: Stare in amazement, O YOU heavens, at this; and bristle up in very great horror,’ is the utterance of Jehovah,

19094.label: Jeremiah 2:13
19094.text: ‘because there are two bad things that my people have done: They have left even me, the source of living water, in order to hew out for themselves cisterns, broken cisterns, that cannot contain the water.’

19095.label: Jeremiah 2:14
19095.text: “‘Is Israel a servant, or a slave born in the household? Why is it that he has come to be for plunder?

19096.label: Jeremiah 2:15
19096.text: Against him maned young lions roar; they have given out their voice. And they went making his land an object of astonishment. His own cities have been set afire, so that there is no inhabitant.

19097.label: Jeremiah 2:16
19097.text: Even the sons of Noph and Tahʹpan·es themselves kept feeding on you at the crown of the head.

19098.label: Jeremiah 2:17
19098.text: Is not this what you proceeded to do to yourself by your leaving Jehovah your God during the time of [his] walking you in the way?

19099.label: Jeremiah 2:18
19099.text: And now what concern should you have for the way of Egypt in order to drink the waters of Shiʹhor? And what concern should you have for the way of As·syrʹi·a in order to drink the waters of the River?

19100.label: Jeremiah 2:19
19100.text: Your badness should correct you, and your own acts of unfaithfulness should reprove you. Know, then, and see that your leaving Jehovah your God is something bad and bitter, and no dread of me [has resulted] to you,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies.

19101.label: Jeremiah 2:20
19101.text: “‘For long ago I broke your yoke to pieces; I tore your bands apart. But you said: “I am not going to serve,” for upon every high hill and under every luxuriant tree you were lying sprawled out, prostituting yourself.

19102.label: Jeremiah 2:21
19102.text: And as for me, I had planted you as a choice red vine, all of it a true seed. So how have you been changed toward me into the degenerate [shoots] of a foreign vine?’

19103.label: Jeremiah 2:22
19103.text: “‘But though you should do the washing with alkali and take to yourself large quantities of lye, your error would certainly be a stain before me,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

19104.label: Jeremiah 2:23
19104.text: How can you say, ‘I have not defiled myself. After the Baʹals I have not walked’? See your way in the valley. Take note of what you have done. A swift young she-camel aimlessly running to and fro in her ways;

19105.label: Jeremiah 2:24
19105.text: a zebra accustomed to the wilderness, at the craving of her soul, snuffing up the wind; at her time for copulation, who can turn her back? All those who are looking for her will not go tiring themselves out. In her month they will find her.

19106.label: Jeremiah 2:25
19106.text: Hold your foot back from [becoming] barefoot, and your throat from thirst. But you proceeded to say, ‘It is hopeless! No, but I have fallen in love with strangers, and after them I am going to walk.’

19107.label: Jeremiah 2:26
19107.text: “As with the shame of a thief when he is found out, so those of the house of Israel have felt shame, they, their kings, their princes and their priests and their prophets.

19108.label: Jeremiah 2:27
19108.text: They are saying to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You yourself brought me to birth.’ But to me they have turned the back of the neck and not the face. And in the time of their calamity they will say, ‘Do rise up and save us!’

19109.label: Jeremiah 2:28
19109.text: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourself? Let them rise up if they can save you in the time of your calamity. For as the number of your cities your gods have become, O Judah.

19110.label: Jeremiah 2:29
19110.text: “‘Why do YOU people keep contending against me? Why have YOU transgressed, all of YOU, against me?’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

19111.label: Jeremiah 2:30
19111.text: To no effect I have struck YOUR sons. No discipline did they take. YOUR sword has devoured YOUR prophets, like a lion that is causing ruin.

19112.label: Jeremiah 2:31
19112.text: O generation, see for yourselves the word of Jehovah. “Have I become a mere wilderness to Israel or a land of intense darkness? Why is it that these, my people, have said, ‘We have roamed. We shall come to you no more’?

19113.label: Jeremiah 2:32
19113.text: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, a bride her breastbands? And yet my own people—they have forgotten me days without number.

19114.label: Jeremiah 2:33
19114.text: “Why do you, O woman, improve your way in order to look for love? Therefore it has also been in bad things that you have taught your ways.

19115.label: Jeremiah 2:34
19115.text: Also, in your skirts there have been found the blood marks of the souls of the innocent poor ones. Not in the act of breaking in have I found them, but [they are] upon all these.

19116.label: Jeremiah 2:35
19116.text: “But you say, ‘I have remained innocent. Surely his anger has turned back from me.’ “Here I am entering into controversy with you on account of your saying, ‘I have not sinned.’

19117.label: Jeremiah 2:36
19117.text: Why do you treat as very insignificant the changing of your way? Of Egypt, too, you will become ashamed, just as you became ashamed of As·syrʹi·a.

19118.label: Jeremiah 2:37
19118.text: For this cause also you will go forth with your hands upon your head, because Jehovah has rejected the objects of your confidence, and you will have no success with them.”

19119.label: Jeremiah 3:1
19119.text: There is a saying: “If a man should send away his wife and she should actually go away from him and become another man’s, should he return to her anymore?” Has that land not positively been polluted? “And you yourself have committed prostitution with many companions; and should there be a returning to me?” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19120.label: Jeremiah 3:2
19120.text: “Raise your eyes to the beaten paths and see. Where is it that you have not been raped? Alongside the ways you have sat for them, like an Arabian in the wilderness; and you keep polluting the land with your acts of prostitution and with your badness.

19121.label: Jeremiah 3:3
19121.text: So copious showers are withheld, and not even a spring rain has occurred. And the forehead of a wife committing prostitution is what has become yours. You have refused to feel humiliated.

19122.label: Jeremiah 3:4
19122.text: Have you from now on called out to me, ‘My Father, you are the confidential friend of my youth!

19123.label: Jeremiah 3:5
19123.text: Should one stay resentful to time indefinite, or keep watching [something] forever?’ Look! You have spoken, and you went on to do bad things and prevail.”

19124.label: Jeremiah 3:6
19124.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to me in the days of Jo·siʹah the king: “‘Have you seen what unfaithful Israel has done? She is going upon every high mountain and underneath every luxuriant tree, that she may commit prostitution there.

19125.label: Jeremiah 3:7
19125.text: And after her doing all these things I kept saying that she should return even to me, but she did not return; and Judah kept looking at her own treacherous sister.

19126.label: Jeremiah 3:8
19126.text: When I got to see that, for the very reason that unfaithful Israel had committed adultery, I sent her away and proceeded to give the certificate of her full divorce to her, yet treacherously dealing Judah her sister did not become afraid, but she herself also began to go and commit prostitution.

19127.label: Jeremiah 3:9
19127.text: And her prostitution occurred because of [her] frivolous view, and she kept polluting the land and committing adultery with stones and with trees;

19128.label: Jeremiah 3:10
19128.text: and even for all this her treacherous sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, only falsely,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19129.label: Jeremiah 3:11
19129.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Unfaithful Israel has proved her own soul to be more righteous than treacherously dealing Judah.

19130.label: Jeremiah 3:12
19130.text: Go, and you must proclaim these words to the north and say: “‘“Do return, O renegade Israel,” is the utterance of Jehovah.’ ‘“I shall not have my face drop [angrily] upon YOU people, for I am loyal,” is the utterance of Jehovah.’ ‘“I shall not stay resentful to time indefinite.

19131.label: Jeremiah 3:13
19131.text: Only take note of your error, for it is against Jehovah your God that you have transgressed. And you continued scattering your ways to the strangers under every luxuriant tree, but to my voice YOU people did not listen,” is the utterance of Jehovah.’”

19132.label: Jeremiah 3:14
19132.text: “Return, O YOU renegade sons,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “For I myself have become the husbandly owner of YOU people; and I will take YOU, one out of a city and two out of a family, and I will bring YOU to Zion.

19133.label: Jeremiah 3:15
19133.text: And I will give YOU shepherds in agreement with my heart, and they will certainly feed YOU with knowledge and insight.

19134.label: Jeremiah 3:16
19134.text: And it must occur that YOU will become many and certainly bear fruit in the land in those days,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “No more will they say, ‘The ark of the covenant of Jehovah!’ nor will it come up into the heart, nor will they remember it or miss it, and no more will it be made.

19135.label: Jeremiah 3:17
19135.text: In that time they will call Jerusalem the throne of Jehovah; and to her all the nations must be brought together to the name of Jehovah at Jerusalem, and they will no more walk after the stubbornness of their bad heart.”

19136.label: Jeremiah 3:18
19136.text: “In those days they will walk, the house of Judah alongside the house of Israel, and together they will come out of the land of the north into the land that I gave as a hereditary possession to YOUR forefathers.

19137.label: Jeremiah 3:19
19137.text: And I myself have said, ‘O how I proceeded to place you among the sons and to give you the desirable land, the hereditary possession of the ornament of the armies of the nations!’ And I further said, ‘“My Father!” YOU people will call out to me, and from following me YOU people will not turn back.’

19138.label: Jeremiah 3:20
19138.text: ‘Truly [as] a wife has treacherously gone from her companion, so YOU, O house of Israel, have dealt treacherously with me,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19139.label: Jeremiah 3:21
19139.text: On the beaten paths there has been heard a sound, the weeping, the entreaties of the sons of Israel. For they have twisted their way; they have forgotten Jehovah their God.

19140.label: Jeremiah 3:22
19140.text: “Return, YOU renegade sons. I shall heal YOUR renegade condition.” “Here we are! We have come to you, for you, O Jehovah, are our God.

19141.label: Jeremiah 3:23
19141.text: Truly the hills as well as the turmoil on the mountains belong to falsehood. Truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.

19142.label: Jeremiah 3:24
19142.text: But the shameful thing itself has eaten up the toil of our forefathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

19143.label: Jeremiah 3:25
19143.text: We lie down in our shame, and our humiliation keeps covering us; for it is toward Jehovah our God that we have sinned, we and our fathers from our youth on and down to this day, and we have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah our God.”

19144.label: Jeremiah 4:1
19144.text: “If you would return, O Israel,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “you may return even to me. And if you will take away your disgusting things on my account, then you will not go as a fugitive.

19145.label: Jeremiah 4:2
19145.text: And [if] you will certainly swear, ‘As Jehovah is alive in truth, in justice and in righteousness!’ then in him the nations will actually bless themselves, and in him they will boast about themselves.”

19146.label: Jeremiah 4:3
19146.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: “Plow for yourselves arable land, and do not keep sowing among thorns.

19147.label: Jeremiah 4:4
19147.text: Get yourselves circumcised to Jehovah, and take away the foreskins of YOUR hearts, YOU men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; that my rage may not go forth just like a fire, and it certainly burn with no one to do the extinguishing, on account of the badness of YOUR dealings.”

19148.label: Jeremiah 4:5
19148.text: Tell [it] in Judah, YOU men, and publish [it] even in Jerusalem, and say [it] out, and blow a horn throughout the land. Call out loudly and say: “Gather yourselves together, and let us enter into the fortified cities.

19149.label: Jeremiah 4:6
19149.text: Raise a signal toward Zion. Make provision for shelter. Do not stand still.” For there is a calamity that I am bringing in from the north, even a great crash.

19150.label: Jeremiah 4:7
19150.text: He has gone up as a lion out of his thicket, and the one who is bringing the nations to ruin has pulled away; he has gone forth from his place in order to render your land as an object of astonishment. Your own cities will fall in ruins so that there will be no inhabitant.

19151.label: Jeremiah 4:8
19151.text: On this account gird on sackcloth, YOU people. Beat YOUR breasts and howl, because the burning anger of Jehovah has not turned back from us.

19152.label: Jeremiah 4:9
19152.text: “And it must occur in that day,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “that the heart of the king will perish, also the heart of the princes; and the priests will certainly be driven to astonishment, and the prophets themselves will be amazed.”

19153.label: Jeremiah 4:10
19153.text: And I proceeded to say: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Truly you have absolutely deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘Peace itself will become YOURS,’ and the sword has reached clear to the soul.”

19154.label: Jeremiah 4:11
19154.text: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem: “There is a searing wind of the beaten paths through the wilderness [on] the way to the daughter of my people; it is not for winnowing, nor for cleansing.

19155.label: Jeremiah 4:12
19155.text: The full wind itself comes even from these to me. Now I myself also shall speak forth the judgments with them.

19156.label: Jeremiah 4:13
19156.text: Look! Like rain clouds he will come up, and his chariots are like a storm wind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us, because we have been despoiled!

19157.label: Jeremiah 4:14
19157.text: Wash your heart clean of sheer badness, O Jerusalem, in order that you may be saved. How long will your erroneous thoughts lodge within you?

19158.label: Jeremiah 4:15
19158.text: For a voice is telling from Dan and is publishing something hurtful from the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im.

19159.label: Jeremiah 4:16
19159.text: Make mention [of it], YOU people, yes, to the nations. Publish [it] against Jerusalem.” “Watchers are coming from a land far away, and they will let out their voice against the very cities of Judah.

19160.label: Jeremiah 4:17
19160.text: Like guards of the open field they have become against her on all sides, because she has rebelled even against me,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19161.label: Jeremiah 4:18
19161.text: “Your way and your dealings—there will be a rendering of these to you. This is the calamity upon you, for it is bitter; because it has reached clear to your heart.”

19162.label: Jeremiah 4:19
19162.text: O my intestines, my intestines! I am in severe pains in the walls of my heart. My heart is boisterous within me. I cannot keep silent, for the sound of the horn is what my soul has heard, the alarm signal of war.

19163.label: Jeremiah 4:20
19163.text: Crash upon crash is what has been called out, for the whole land has been despoiled. Suddenly my tents have been despoiled, in a moment my tent cloths.

19164.label: Jeremiah 4:21
19164.text: How long shall I keep seeing the signal, keep hearing the sound of the horn?

19165.label: Jeremiah 4:22
19165.text: For my people is foolish. Of me they have not taken note. They are unwise sons; and they are not those having understanding. Wise they are for doing bad, but for doing good they actually have no knowledge.

19166.label: Jeremiah 4:23
19166.text: I saw the land, and, look! [it was] empty and waste; and into the heavens, and their light was no more.

19167.label: Jeremiah 4:24
19167.text: I saw the mountains, and, look! they were rocking, and the hills themselves were all given a shaking.

19168.label: Jeremiah 4:25
19168.text: I saw, and, look! there was not an earthling man, and the flying creatures of the heavens had all fled.

19169.label: Jeremiah 4:26
19169.text: I saw, and, look! the orchard itself was a wilderness, and the very cities of it had all been torn down. It was because of Jehovah, because of his burning anger.

19170.label: Jeremiah 4:27
19170.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “A desolate waste is what the whole land will become, and shall I not carry out a sheer extermination?

19171.label: Jeremiah 4:28
19171.text: On this account the land will mourn, and the heavens above will certainly become dark. It is because I have spoken, I have considered, and I have not felt regret, nor shall I turn back from it.

19172.label: Jeremiah 4:29
19172.text: Because of the sound of the horsemen and bow shooters the entire city is running away. They have entered into the thickets, and into the rocks they have gone up. Every city is left, and there is no man dwelling in them.”

19173.label: Jeremiah 4:30
19173.text: Now that you are despoiled, what will you do, since you used to clothe yourself with scarlet, since you used to deck yourself with ornaments of gold, since you used to enlarge your eyes with black paint? It is in vain that you used to make yourself pretty. Those lusting after [you] have rejected you; they keep seeking for your very soul.

19174.label: Jeremiah 4:31
19174.text: For a voice like that of a sick woman I have heard, the distress like that of a woman giving birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion who keeps gasping for breath. She keeps spreading out her palms: “Woe, now, to me, for my soul is tired of the killers!”

19175.label: Jeremiah 5:1
19175.text: Go roving about in the streets of Jerusalem and see, now, and know, and seek for yourselves in her public squares whether YOU can find a man, whether there exists anyone doing justice, anyone seeking faithfulness, and I shall forgive her.

19176.label: Jeremiah 5:2
19176.text: Even if they should say: “As Jehovah is alive!” they would thereby be swearing to sheer falsehood.

19177.label: Jeremiah 5:3
19177.text: O Jehovah, are not those eyes of yours toward faithfulness? You have struck them, but they did not become ill. You exterminated them. They refused to take discipline. They made their faces harder than a crag. They refused to turn back.

19178.label: Jeremiah 5:4
19178.text: Even I myself had said: “Surely they are of low class. They acted foolishly, for they have ignored the way of Jehovah, the judgment of their God.

19179.label: Jeremiah 5:5
19179.text: I will go my way to the great ones and speak with them; for they themselves must have taken note of the way of Jehovah, the judgment of their God. Surely they themselves must have all together broken the yoke; they must have torn apart the bands.”

19180.label: Jeremiah 5:6
19180.text: That is why a lion out of the forest has struck them, a wolf itself of the desert plains keeps despoiling them, a leopard is keeping awake at their cities. Everyone going forth from them gets torn to pieces. For their transgressions have become many; their acts of unfaithfulness have become numerous.

19181.label: Jeremiah 5:7
19181.text: How can I forgive you for this very thing? Your own sons have left me, and they keep swearing by what is no God. And I kept satisfying them, but they continued committing adultery, and to the house of a prostitute woman they go in troops.

19182.label: Jeremiah 5:8
19182.text: Horses seized with sexual heat, having [strong] testicles, they have become. They neigh each one to the wife of his companion.

19183.label: Jeremiah 5:9
19183.text: “Should I not take an accounting because of these very things?” is the utterance of Jehovah. “Or upon a nation that is like this should not my soul avenge itself?”

19184.label: Jeremiah 5:10
19184.text: “Come up against her [vine] rows and cause ruin, but do not YOU men make an actual extermination. Take away her luxuriating shoots, for they do not belong to Jehovah.

19185.label: Jeremiah 5:11
19185.text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have positively dealt treacherously with me,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19186.label: Jeremiah 5:12
19186.text: “They have denied Jehovah, and they keep saying, ‘He is not. And upon us no calamity will come, and no sword or famine shall we see.’

19187.label: Jeremiah 5:13
19187.text: And the prophets themselves become a wind, and the word is not in them. That is how it will be done to them.”

19188.label: Jeremiah 5:14
19188.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, has said: “For the reason that YOU men are saying this thing, here I am making my words in your mouth a fire, and this people will be pieces of wood, and it will certainly devour them.”

19189.label: Jeremiah 5:15
19189.text: “Here I am bringing in upon YOU men a nation from far away, O house of Israel,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “It is an enduring nation. It is a nation of long ago, a nation whose language you do not know, and you cannot hear [understandingly] what they speak.

19190.label: Jeremiah 5:16
19190.text: Their quiver is like an open burial place; all of them are mighty men.

19191.label: Jeremiah 5:17
19191.text: They will also certainly eat up your harvest and your bread. The men will eat up your sons and your daughters. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vine and your fig tree. They will shatter with the sword your fortified cities in which you are trusting.”

19192.label: Jeremiah 5:18
19192.text: “And even in those days,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “I shall not carry out an extermination of YOU men.

19193.label: Jeremiah 5:19
19193.text: And it must occur that YOU will say, ‘Due to what fact has Jehovah our God done to us all these things?’ And you must say to them, ‘Just as YOU have left me and have gone serving a foreign god in YOUR land, so YOU will serve strangers in a land that is not YOURS.’”

19194.label: Jeremiah 5:20
19194.text: TELL this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying:

19195.label: Jeremiah 5:21
19195.text: “Hear, now, this, O unwise people that is without heart: They have eyes, but they cannot see; they have ears, but they cannot hear.

19196.label: Jeremiah 5:22
19196.text: ‘Do YOU not fear even me,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘or are YOU in no severe pains even because of me, who have set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an indefinitely lasting regulation that it cannot pass over? Although its waves toss themselves, still they cannot prevail; and [although] they do become boisterous, still they cannot pass over it.

19197.label: Jeremiah 5:23
19197.text: But this very people has come to have a stubborn and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and keep walking in their course.

19198.label: Jeremiah 5:24
19198.text: But they have not said in their heart: “Let us, now, fear Jehovah our God, the One who is giving the downpour and the autumn rain and the spring rain in its season, the One who guards even the prescribed weeks of the harvest for us.”

19199.label: Jeremiah 5:25
19199.text: YOUR own errors have turned these things away, and YOUR own sins have held back what is good from YOU people.

19200.label: Jeremiah 5:26
19200.text: “‘For among my people there have been found wicked men. They keep peering, as when birdcatchers crouch down. They have set a ruinous [trap]. It is men that they catch.

19201.label: Jeremiah 5:27
19201.text: As a cage is full of flying creatures, so their houses are full of deception. That is why they have become great and they gain riches.

19202.label: Jeremiah 5:28
19202.text: They have grown fat; they have become shiny. They have also overflowed with bad things. No legal case have they pleaded, even the legal case of the fatherless boy, that they may gain success; and the judgment of the poor ones they have not taken up.’”

19203.label: Jeremiah 5:29
19203.text: “Should I not hold an accounting because of these very things,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “or on a nation that is like this should not my soul avenge itself?

19204.label: Jeremiah 5:30
19204.text: An astonishing situation, even a horrible thing, has been brought to be in the land:

19205.label: Jeremiah 5:31
19205.text: The prophets themselves actually prophesy in falsehood; and as for the priests, they go subduing according to their powers. And my own people have loved [it] that way; and what will YOU men do in the finale of it?”

19206.label: Jeremiah 6:1
19206.text: Take shelter, O YOU sons of Benjamin, from the midst of Jerusalem; and in Te·koʹa blow the horn. And over Beth-hac·cheʹrem raise a fire signal; because calamity itself has looked down out of the north, even a great crash.

19207.label: Jeremiah 6:2
19207.text: The daughter of Zion has resembled indeed a comely and daintily bred woman.

19208.label: Jeremiah 6:3
19208.text: To her the shepherds and their droves proceeded to come. Against her they pitched [their] tents all around. They grazed off each one his own part.

19209.label: Jeremiah 6:4
19209.text: Against her they have sanctified war: “Rise up, and let us go up at midday!” “Woe to us, for the day has declined, for the shadows of evening keep extending themselves!”

19210.label: Jeremiah 6:5
19210.text: “Rise up, and let us go up during the night and bring to ruin her dwelling towers.”

19211.label: Jeremiah 6:6
19211.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies has said: “Cut down wood and throw up against Jerusalem a siege rampart. She is the city with which an accounting must be held. She is nothing but oppression in the midst of her.

19212.label: Jeremiah 6:7
19212.text: As a cistern keeps its waters cool, so she has kept her badness cool. Violence and despoiling are heard in her; sickness and plague are before my face constantly.

19213.label: Jeremiah 6:8
19213.text: Be corrected, O Jerusalem, that my soul may not turn away disgusted from you; that I may not set you as a desolate waste, a land not inhabited.”

19214.label: Jeremiah 6:9
19214.text: This is what Jehovah of armies has said: “They will without fail glean the remnant of Israel just like a vine. Put your hand back like one that is gathering grapes upon the vine tendrils.”

19215.label: Jeremiah 6:10
19215.text: “To whom shall I speak and give warning, that they may hear? Look! Their ear is uncircumcised, so that they are unable to pay attention. Look! The very word of Jehovah has become to them a reproach, in which [word] they can take no delight.

19216.label: Jeremiah 6:11
19216.text: And with the rage of Jehovah I have become full. I have become weary with holding in.” “Pour [it] out upon the child in the street and upon the intimate group of young men at the same time; for they will also be caught, a man along with his wife, an old man along with one that is full of days.

19217.label: Jeremiah 6:12
19217.text: And their houses will certainly be turned over to others for possession, the fields and the wives at the same time. For I shall stretch my hand out against the inhabitants of the land,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19218.label: Jeremiah 6:13
19218.text: “For from the least one of them even to the greatest one of them, every one is making for himself unjust gain; and from the prophet even to the priest, each one is acting falsely.

19219.label: Jeremiah 6:14
19219.text: And they try to heal the breakdown of my people lightly, saying, ‘There is peace! There is peace!’ when there is no peace.

19220.label: Jeremiah 6:15
19220.text: Did they feel shame because it was something detestable that they had done? For one thing, they positively do not feel any shame; for another thing, they have not come to know even how to feel humiliated. Therefore they will fall among those who are falling; in the time that I must hold an accounting with them they will stumble,” Jehovah has said.

19221.label: Jeremiah 6:16
19221.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Stand still in the ways, YOU people, and see, and ask for the roadways of long ago, where, now, the good way is; and walk in it, and find ease for YOUR souls.” But they kept saying: “We are not going to walk.”

19222.label: Jeremiah 6:17
19222.text: “And I raised up over YOU people watchmen, ‘Pay attention to the sound of the horn!’” But they kept saying: “We are not going to pay attention.”

19223.label: Jeremiah 6:18
19223.text: “Therefore hear, O YOU nations! And know, O you assembly, what will be among them.

19224.label: Jeremiah 6:19
19224.text: Listen, O earth! Here I am bringing in calamity upon this people as the fruitage of their thoughts, for they paid no attention to my very own words; and my law—they also kept rejecting it.”

19225.label: Jeremiah 6:20
19225.text: “What does this matter to me that you bring in even frankincense from Sheʹba and the good cane from the land far away? The whole burnt offerings of YOU people serve for no pleasure, and YOUR very sacrifices have not been gratifying to me.”

19226.label: Jeremiah 6:21
19226.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am setting for this people stumbling blocks, and they will certainly stumble over them, fathers and sons together; the neighbor and his companion—they will perish.”

19227.label: Jeremiah 6:22
19227.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Look! A people is coming from the land of the north, and there is a great nation that will be awakened from the remotest parts of the earth.

19228.label: Jeremiah 6:23
19228.text: The bow and the javelin they will grab hold of. It is a cruel one, and they will have no pity. Their very voice will resound just like the sea, and upon horses they will ride. It is drawn up in battle order like a man of war against you, O daughter of Zion.”

19229.label: Jeremiah 6:24
19229.text: We have heard the report about it. Our hands have dropped. Distress itself has seized hold of us, labor pains like those of a woman giving birth.

19230.label: Jeremiah 6:25
19230.text: Do not go out into the field, and do not walk even in the way; for there is the sword belonging to the enemy, there is fright all around.

19231.label: Jeremiah 6:26
19231.text: O daughter of my people, gird on sackcloth and wallow in the ashes. Make your mourning that for an only [son], the wailing of bitterness; because suddenly the despoiler will come upon us.

19232.label: Jeremiah 6:27
19232.text: “I have made you a metal tester among my people, one making a thorough search; and you will take note and you must examine their way.

19233.label: Jeremiah 6:28
19233.text: All of them are the most stubborn men, walking about as slanderers —copper and iron. They are all of them ruinous.

19234.label: Jeremiah 6:29
19234.text: The bellows have been scorched. Out from their fire there is lead. One has kept refining intensely simply for nothing, and those who are bad have not been separated.

19235.label: Jeremiah 6:30
19235.text: Rejected silver is what people will certainly call them, for Jehovah has rejected them.”

19236.label: Jeremiah 7:1
19236.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19237.label: Jeremiah 7:2
19237.text: “Stand in the gate of the house of Jehovah, and you must proclaim there this word, and you must say, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah, all YOU of Judah, who are entering into these gates to bow down to Jehovah.

19238.label: Jeremiah 7:3
19238.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “Make YOUR ways and YOUR dealings good, and I will keep YOU people residing in this place.

19239.label: Jeremiah 7:4
19239.text: Do not put YOUR trust in fallacious words, saying, ‘The temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah they are!’

19240.label: Jeremiah 7:5
19240.text: For if YOU will positively make YOUR ways and YOUR dealings good, if YOU will positively carry out justice between a man and his companion,

19241.label: Jeremiah 7:6
19241.text: if no alien resident, no fatherless boy and no widow YOU will oppress, and innocent blood YOU will not shed in this place, and after other gods YOU will not walk for calamity to yourselves,

19242.label: Jeremiah 7:7
19242.text: I, in turn, shall certainly keep YOU residing in this place, in the land that I gave to YOUR forefathers, from time indefinite even to time indefinite.”’”

19243.label: Jeremiah 7:8
19243.text: “Here YOU are putting YOUR trust in fallacious words—it will certainly be of no benefit at all.

19244.label: Jeremiah 7:9
19244.text: Can there be stealing, murdering and committing adultery and swearing falsely and making sacrificial smoke to Baʹal and walking after other gods whom YOU had not known,

19245.label: Jeremiah 7:10
19245.text: and must YOU come and stand before me in this house upon which my name has been called, and must YOU say, ‘We shall certainly be delivered,’ in the face of doing all these detestable things?

19246.label: Jeremiah 7:11
19246.text: Has this house upon which my name has been called become a mere cave of robbers in YOUR eyes? Here I myself also have seen [it],” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19247.label: Jeremiah 7:12
19247.text: “‘However, GO, now, to my place that was in Shiʹloh, where I caused my name to reside at first, and see what I did to it because of the badness of my people Israel.

19248.label: Jeremiah 7:13
19248.text: And now for the reason that YOU kept doing all these works,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I kept speaking to YOU, getting up early and speaking, but YOU did not listen, and I kept calling YOU, but YOU did not answer,

19249.label: Jeremiah 7:14
19249.text: I will do also to the house upon which my name has been called, in which YOU are trusting, and to the place that I gave to YOU and to YOUR forefathers, just as I did to Shiʹloh.

19250.label: Jeremiah 7:15
19250.text: And I will throw YOU out from before my face, just as I threw out all YOUR brothers, the whole offspring of Eʹphra·im.’

19251.label: Jeremiah 7:16
19251.text: “And as for you, do not pray in behalf of this people, neither raise in their behalf an entreating cry or a prayer nor beseech me, for I shall not be listening to you.

19252.label: Jeremiah 7:17
19252.text: Are you not seeing what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

19253.label: Jeremiah 7:18
19253.text: The sons are picking up sticks of wood, and the fathers are lighting the fire, and the wives are kneading flour dough in order to make sacrificial cakes to the ‘queen of the heavens’; and there is a pouring out of drink offerings to other gods for the purpose of offending me.

19254.label: Jeremiah 7:19
19254.text: ‘Is it I whom they are offending?’ is the utterance of Jehovah. ‘Is it not they themselves, for the purpose of shame to their faces?’

19255.label: Jeremiah 7:20
19255.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Look! My anger and my rage are being poured forth upon this place, upon mankind and upon domestic animal, and upon the tree of the field and upon the fruitage of the ground; and it must burn, and it will not be extinguished.’

19256.label: Jeremiah 7:21
19256.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Add those whole burnt offerings of YOURS to YOUR sacrifices and eat flesh.

19257.label: Jeremiah 7:22
19257.text: For I did not speak with YOUR forefathers, nor did I command them in the day of my bringing them out from the land of Egypt concerning the matters of whole burnt offering and sacrifice.

19258.label: Jeremiah 7:23
19258.text: But this word I did express in command upon them, saying: “Obey my voice, and I will become YOUR God, and YOU yourselves will become my people; and YOU must walk in all the way that I shall command YOU, in order that it may go well with YOU.”’

19259.label: Jeremiah 7:24
19259.text: But they did not listen, neither did they incline their ear, but they went walking in the counsels in the stubbornness of their bad heart, so that they became backward in direction and not forward,

19260.label: Jeremiah 7:25
19260.text: from the day that YOUR forefathers came forth out of the land of Egypt until this day; and I kept sending to YOU all my servants the prophets, daily getting up early and sending [them].

19261.label: Jeremiah 7:26
19261.text: But they did not listen to me, and they did not incline their ear, but they kept hardening their neck. They acted worse than their forefathers!

19262.label: Jeremiah 7:27
19262.text: “And you must speak to them all these words, but they will not listen to you; and you must call to them, but they will not answer you.

19263.label: Jeremiah 7:28
19263.text: And you must say to them, ‘This is the nation whose people have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah its God, and have not taken discipline. Faithfulness has perished, and it has been cut off from their mouth.’

19264.label: Jeremiah 7:29
19264.text: “Shear off your uncut hair and throw [it] away, and upon the bare hills raise a dirge, for Jehovah has rejected and will desert the generation with which he is furious.

19265.label: Jeremiah 7:30
19265.text: ‘For the sons of Judah have done what is bad in my eyes,’ is the utterance of Jehovah. ‘They have set their disgusting things in the house upon which my name has been called, in order to defile it.

19266.label: Jeremiah 7:31
19266.text: And they have built the high places of Toʹpheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinʹnom, in order to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, a thing that I had not commanded and that had not come up into my heart.’

19267.label: Jeremiah 7:32
19267.text: “‘Therefore, look! days are coming,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘when it will no more be said [to be] Toʹpheth and the valley of the son of Hinʹnom, but the valley of the killing; and they will have to bury in Toʹpheth without there being enough place.

19268.label: Jeremiah 7:33
19268.text: And the dead bodies of this people must become food for the flying creatures of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, with nobody to make [them] tremble.

19269.label: Jeremiah 7:34
19269.text: And I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of exultation and the voice of rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become nothing but a devastated place.’”

19270.label: Jeremiah 8:1
19270.text: “At that time,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “people will also bring forth the bones of the kings of Judah and the bones of its princes and the bones of the priests and the bones of the prophets and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem from their graves.

19271.label: Jeremiah 8:2
19271.text: And they will actually spread them out to the sun and to the moon and to all the army of the heavens that they have loved and that they have served and that they have walked after and that they have sought and that they have bowed down to. They will not be gathered, nor will they be buried. As manure upon the face of the ground they will become.”

19272.label: Jeremiah 8:3
19272.text: “And death will certainly be chosen rather than life on the part of all the remnant of those remaining out of this bad family in all the places of the remaining ones, where I will have dispersed them,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies.

19273.label: Jeremiah 8:4
19273.text: “And you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Will they fall and not get up again? If one would turn back, will the other not also turn back?

19274.label: Jeremiah 8:5
19274.text: Why is it that this people, Jerusalem, is unfaithful with an enduring unfaithfulness? They have taken hold of trickiness; they have refused to turn back.

19275.label: Jeremiah 8:6
19275.text: I have paid attention, and I kept listening. It was not right the way they kept speaking. There was not a man repenting over his badness, saying, ‘What have I done?’ Each one is going back into the popular course, like a horse that is dashing into the battle.

19276.label: Jeremiah 8:7
19276.text: Even the stork in the heavens—it well knows its appointed times; and the turtledove and the swift and the bulbul—they observe well the time of each one’s coming in. But as for my people, they have not come to know the judgment of Jehovah.”’

19277.label: Jeremiah 8:8
19277.text: “‘How can YOU men say: “We are wise, and the law of Jehovah is with us”? Surely, now, the false stylus of the secretaries has worked in sheer falsehood.

19278.label: Jeremiah 8:9
19278.text: The wise ones have become ashamed. They have become terrified and will be caught. Look! They have rejected the very word of Jehovah, and what wisdom do they have?

19279.label: Jeremiah 8:10
19279.text: Therefore I shall give their wives to other men, their fields to those taking possession; for, from the least one even to the greatest one, each one is making unjust gain; from the prophet even to the priest, each one is acting falsely.

19280.label: Jeremiah 8:11
19280.text: And they try to heal the breakdown of the daughter of my people lightly, saying: “There is peace! There is peace!” when there is no peace.

19281.label: Jeremiah 8:12
19281.text: Did they feel shame because they had done even what was detestable? For one thing, they positively could not feel ashamed; for another thing, they did not know even how to feel humiliated. “‘Therefore they will fall among those who are falling. In the time of their being given attention, they will stumble,’ Jehovah has said.

19282.label: Jeremiah 8:13
19282.text: “‘When doing the gathering, I shall bring them to their finish,’ is the utterance of Jehovah. ‘There will be no grapes on the vine, and there will be no figs on the fig tree, and the foliage itself will certainly wither. And things that I give to them will pass by them.’”

19283.label: Jeremiah 8:14
19283.text: “Why are we sitting still? Gather yourselves together, and let us enter into the fortified cities and be silent there. For Jehovah our God has himself put us to silence, and he gives us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against Jehovah.

19284.label: Jeremiah 8:15
19284.text: There was a hoping for peace, but no good [came]; for a time of healing, but, look! terror!

19285.label: Jeremiah 8:16
19285.text: From Dan has been heard the snorting of his horses. Due to the sound of the neighing of his stallions the whole land has begun to rock. And they come in and eat up the land and what fills it, the city and its inhabitants.”

19286.label: Jeremiah 8:17
19286.text: “For here I am sending in among YOU serpents, poisonous snakes, for which there is no charming, and they will certainly bite YOU,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19287.label: Jeremiah 8:18
19287.text: A grief that is beyond curing has come up into me. My heart is ill.

19288.label: Jeremiah 8:19
19288.text: Here there is the sound of the cry for help of the daughter of my people from a land far away: “Is Jehovah not in Zion? Or is her king not in her?” “Why is it that they have offended me with their graven images, with their vain foreign gods?”

19289.label: Jeremiah 8:20
19289.text: “The harvest has passed, the summer has come to an end; but as for us, we have not been saved!”

19290.label: Jeremiah 8:21
19290.text: Over the breakdown of the daughter of my people I have become shattered. I have grown sad. Outright astonishment has seized hold of me.

19291.label: Jeremiah 8:22
19291.text: Is there no balsam in Gilʹe·ad? Or is there no healer there? Why is it, then, that the recuperation of the daughter of my people has not come up?

19292.label: Jeremiah 9:1
19292.text: O that my head were waters, and that my eyes were a source of tears! Then I could weep day and night for the slain ones of the daughter of my people.

19293.label: Jeremiah 9:2
19293.text: O that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of travelers! Then I would leave my people and go away from them, for all of them are adulterers, a solemn assembly of treacherous dealers;

19294.label: Jeremiah 9:3
19294.text: and they bend their tongue as their bow in falsehood; but not for faithfulness have they proved mighty in the land. “For from badness to badness they went forth, and they ignored even me,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19295.label: Jeremiah 9:4
19295.text: “Guard yourselves each one against his own companion, and put YOUR trust in no brother at all. For even every brother would positively supplant, and every companion himself would walk around as a mere slanderer,

19296.label: Jeremiah 9:5
19296.text: and they keep trifling each one with his companion; and they speak no truth at all. They have taught their tongue to speak falsehood. They have tired themselves out merely in doing wrong.

19297.label: Jeremiah 9:6
19297.text: “Your sitting is in the midst of deception. Through deception they have refused to know me,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19298.label: Jeremiah 9:7
19298.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies has said: “Here I am smelting them, and I have to examine them, because how otherwise shall I act on account of the daughter of my people?

19299.label: Jeremiah 9:8
19299.text: Their tongue is a slaughtering arrow. Deception is what it has spoken. With his mouth, peace is what [a person] keeps speaking with his own companion; but within himself he sets his ambush.”

19300.label: Jeremiah 9:9
19300.text: “Because of these things should I not hold an accounting with them?” is the utterance of Jehovah. “Or upon a nation that is like this should not my soul avenge itself?

19301.label: Jeremiah 9:10
19301.text: Over the mountains I shall raise a weeping and lamentation, and over the pasture grounds of the wilderness a dirge; for they will have been burned so that there is no man passing through and people actually will not hear the sound of livestock. Both the flying creature of the heavens and the beast will have fled; they will have gone.

19302.label: Jeremiah 9:11
19302.text: And I will make Jerusalem piles of stones, the lair of jackals; and the cities of Judah I shall make a desolate waste, without an inhabitant.

19303.label: Jeremiah 9:12
19303.text: “Who is the man that is wise, that he may understand this, even the one to whom the mouth of Jehovah has spoken, that he may tell it? On what account should the land actually perish, be actually burned like the wilderness without anyone passing through?”

19304.label: Jeremiah 9:13
19304.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say: “On account of their leaving my law that I gave [to be] before them, and [because] they have not obeyed my voice and have not walked in it,

19305.label: Jeremiah 9:14
19305.text: but they kept on walking after the stubbornness of their heart and after the Baʹal images, about which their fathers had taught them;

19306.label: Jeremiah 9:15
19306.text: therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Here I am making them, that is, this people, eat wormwood, and I will make them drink poisoned water;

19307.label: Jeremiah 9:16
19307.text: and I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send after them the sword until I shall have exterminated them.’

19308.label: Jeremiah 9:17
19308.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies has said, ‘Behave with understanding, YOU people, and call the dirge-chanting women, that they may come; and send even to the skilled women, that they may come,

19309.label: Jeremiah 9:18
19309.text: and that they may hurry and raise up over us a lamentation. And may our eyes run down with tears and our own beaming eyes trickle with waters.

19310.label: Jeremiah 9:19
19310.text: For the voice of lamentation is what has been heard from Zion: “How we have been despoiled! How much we have felt shame! For we have left the land; for they have thrown away our residences.”

19311.label: Jeremiah 9:20
19311.text: But hear, O YOU women, the word of Jehovah, and may YOUR ear take the word of his mouth. Then teach YOUR daughters a lamentation, and each woman her companion a dirge.

19312.label: Jeremiah 9:21
19312.text: For death has come up through our windows; it has come into our dwelling towers, in order to cut off the child from the street, the young men from the public squares.’

19313.label: Jeremiah 9:22
19313.text: “Speak, ‘This is what the utterance of Jehovah is: “The dead bodies of mankind must also fall like manure upon the face of the field and like a row of newly cut grain after the reaper, with no one to do the gathering up.”’”

19314.label: Jeremiah 9:23
19314.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Let not the wise man brag about himself because of his wisdom, and let not the mighty man brag about himself because of his mightiness. Let not the rich man brag about himself because of his riches.”

19315.label: Jeremiah 9:24
19315.text: “But let the one bragging about himself brag about himself because of this very thing, the having of insight and the having of knowledge of me, that I am Jehovah, the One exercising loving-kindness, justice and righteousness in the earth; for in these things I do take delight,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19316.label: Jeremiah 9:25
19316.text: “Look! Days are coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I will hold an accounting with everyone circumcised [but still] in uncircumcision,

19317.label: Jeremiah 9:26
19317.text: upon Egypt and upon Judah and upon Eʹdom and upon the sons of Amʹmon and upon Moʹab and upon all those with hair clipped at the temples who are dwelling in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

19318.label: Jeremiah 10:1
19318.text: Hear the word that Jehovah has spoken against YOU people, O house of Israel.

19319.label: Jeremiah 10:2
19319.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Do not learn the way of the nations at all, and do not be struck with terror even at the signs of the heavens, because the nations are struck with terror at them.

19320.label: Jeremiah 10:3
19320.text: For the customs of the peoples are just an exhalation, because it is a mere tree out of the forest that one has cut down, the work of the hands of the craftsman with the billhook.

19321.label: Jeremiah 10:4
19321.text: With silver and with gold one makes it pretty. With nails and with hammers they fasten them down, that none may reel.

19322.label: Jeremiah 10:5
19322.text: They are like a scarecrow of a cucumber field, and cannot speak. Without fail they are carried, for they cannot take any steps. Do not be afraid because of them, for they can do nothing calamitous and, what is more, the doing of any good is not with them.”

19323.label: Jeremiah 10:6
19323.text: In no way is there anyone like you, O Jehovah. You are great, and your name is great in mightiness.

19324.label: Jeremiah 10:7
19324.text: Who should not fear you, O King of the nations, for to you it is fitting; because among all the wise ones of the nations and among all their kingships there is in no way anyone like you.

19325.label: Jeremiah 10:8
19325.text: And at one and the same time they prove to be unreasoning and stupid. A tree is a mere exhortation of vanities.

19326.label: Jeremiah 10:9
19326.text: Silver beaten into plates is what is brought in even from Tarʹshish, and gold from Uʹphaz, the workmanship of a craftsman and of the hands of a metalworker; their clothing is blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple. They are all the workmanship of skilled people.

19327.label: Jeremiah 10:10
19327.text: But Jehovah is in truth God. He is the living God and the King to time indefinite. Because of his indignation the earth will rock, and no nations will hold up under his denunciation.

19328.label: Jeremiah 10:11
19328.text: This is what YOU men will say to them: “The gods that did not make the very heavens and the earth are the ones who will perish from the earth and from under these heavens.”

19329.label: Jeremiah 10:12
19329.text: He is the Maker of the earth by his power, the One firmly establishing the productive land by his wisdom, and the One who by his understanding stretched out the heavens.

19330.label: Jeremiah 10:13
19330.text: At [his] voice there is a giving by him of a turmoil of waters in the heavens, and he causes vapors to ascend from the extremity of the earth. He has made even sluices for the rain, and he brings forth the wind from his storehouses.

19331.label: Jeremiah 10:14
19331.text: Every man has behaved so unreasoningly as not to know. Every metalworker will certainly feel shame because of the carved image; for his molten image is a falsehood, and there is no spirit in them.

19332.label: Jeremiah 10:15
19332.text: They are vanity, a work of mockery. In the time of their being given attention they will perish.

19333.label: Jeremiah 10:16
19333.text: The Share of Jacob is not like these things, for he is the Former of everything, and Israel is the staff of his inheritance. Jehovah of armies is his name.

19334.label: Jeremiah 10:17
19334.text: Gather up from the earth your pack load, O woman dwelling under stress.

19335.label: Jeremiah 10:18
19335.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am slinging out the inhabitants of the earth on this occasion, and I will cause them distress in order that they may find out.”

19336.label: Jeremiah 10:19
19336.text: Woe to me on account of my breakdown! My stroke has become sickish. And I myself have said: “Surely this is my sickness, and I shall carry it.

19337.label: Jeremiah 10:20
19337.text: My own tent has been despoiled, and my own tent cords have all been torn in two. My own sons have gone forth from me, and they are no more. There is no one stretching out my tent anymore or raising up my tent cloths.

19338.label: Jeremiah 10:21
19338.text: For the shepherds have behaved unreasoningly, and they have not looked even for Jehovah. That is why they have not acted with insight, and all their pastured animals have been scattered.”

19339.label: Jeremiah 10:22
19339.text: Listen! A report! Here it has come, also a great pounding from the land of the north, in order to make the cities of Judah a desolate waste, the lair of jackals.

19340.label: Jeremiah 10:23
19340.text: I well know, O Jehovah, that to earthling man his way does not belong. It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step.

19341.label: Jeremiah 10:24
19341.text: Correct me, O Jehovah, however with judgment; not in your anger, that you may not reduce me to nothing.

19342.label: Jeremiah 10:25
19342.text: Pour out your rage upon the nations who have ignored you, and upon the families who have not called even upon your name. For they have eaten up Jacob. Yes, they have eaten him up, and they keep at exterminating him; and his abiding place they have desolated.

19343.label: Jeremiah 11:1
19343.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19344.label: Jeremiah 11:2
19344.text: “Hear the words of this covenant, YOU men! “And you must speak them to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,

19345.label: Jeremiah 11:3
19345.text: and you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said: “Cursed is the man that does not listen to the words of this covenant,

19346.label: Jeremiah 11:4
19346.text: which I commanded YOUR forefathers in the day of my bringing them out of the land of Egypt, out of the furnace of iron, saying, ‘Obey my voice, and YOU must do things according to all that I command YOU; and YOU will certainly become my people and I myself shall become YOUR God,

19347.label: Jeremiah 11:5
19347.text: for the purpose of carrying out the oath that I swore to YOUR forefathers, to give them the land flowing with milk and honey, as in this day.’”’” And I proceeded to answer and say: “Amen, O Jehovah.”

19348.label: Jeremiah 11:6
19348.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear, YOU people, the words of this covenant, and YOU must do them.

19349.label: Jeremiah 11:7
19349.text: For I solemnly admonished YOUR forefathers in the day of my bringing them up out of the land of Egypt and down to this day, rising up early and admonishing, saying: “Obey my voice.”

19350.label: Jeremiah 11:8
19350.text: But they did not listen or incline their ear, but they kept walking each one in the stubbornness of their bad heart; and so I brought upon them all the words of this covenant that I commanded [them] to do, but that they did not do.’”

19351.label: Jeremiah 11:9
19351.text: Furthermore, Jehovah said to me: “Conspiracy has been found among the men of Judah and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

19352.label: Jeremiah 11:10
19352.text: They have returned to the errors of their forefathers, the first ones, who refused to obey my words, but who themselves have walked after other gods in order to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant that I concluded with their forefathers.

19353.label: Jeremiah 11:11
19353.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am bringing upon them a calamity that they will not be able to get out of; and they will certainly call to me for aid, but I shall not listen to them.

19354.label: Jeremiah 11:12
19354.text: And the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will have to go and call for aid to the gods to which they are making sacrificial smoke, but which will positively bring no salvation to them in the time of their calamity.

19355.label: Jeremiah 11:13
19355.text: For your gods have become as many as your cities, O Judah; and as many altars as the streets of Jerusalem YOU people have placed for the shameful thing, altars to make sacrificial smoke to Baʹal.’

19356.label: Jeremiah 11:14
19356.text: “And as for you, do not pray in behalf of this people, and do not lift up in their behalf an entreating cry or a prayer, for I shall not be listening in the time of their calling out to me in regard to their calamity.

19357.label: Jeremiah 11:15
19357.text: “What business does my beloved one have in my house, that many of them should do this thing, the [evil] device? And with holy flesh will they make [it] pass over from upon you, when your calamity [comes]? At that time will you exult?

19358.label: Jeremiah 11:16
19358.text: ‘A luxuriant olive tree, pretty with fruit [and] in form,’ is what Jehovah has called your name. With sound of the great roaring, he has set a fire blazing against her, and they have broken its branches.

19359.label: Jeremiah 11:17
19359.text: “And Jehovah of armies himself, the Planter of you, has spoken against you a calamity on account of the badness of the house of Israel and the house of Judah that they have committed on their own part to offend me in making sacrificial smoke to Baʹal.”

19360.label: Jeremiah 11:18
19360.text: And Jehovah himself has informed me that I may know. At that time you caused me to see their dealings.

19361.label: Jeremiah 11:19
19361.text: And I was like a male lamb, an intimate one, that is brought to slaughter, and I did not know that it was against me that they thought out schemes: “Let us bring to ruin the tree with its food, and let us cut him off from the land of the living ones, that his very name may no more be remembered.”

19362.label: Jeremiah 11:20
19362.text: But Jehovah of armies is judging with righteousness; he is examining the kidneys and the heart. O may I see your vengeance on them, for it is to you that I have revealed my case at law.

19363.label: Jeremiah 11:21
19363.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said against the men of Anʹa·thoth who are seeking for your soul, saying: “You must not prophesy in the name of Jehovah, that you may not die at our hand”;

19364.label: Jeremiah 11:22
19364.text: therefore this is what Jehovah of armies has said: “Here I am turning my attention upon them. The young men themselves will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters themselves will die by the famine.

19365.label: Jeremiah 11:23
19365.text: And not even a remnant will there come to be for them, because I shall bring calamity upon the men of Anʹa·thoth, the year of their being given attention.”

19366.label: Jeremiah 12:1
19366.text: You are righteous, O Jehovah, when I make my complaint to you, indeed when I speak even about matters of judgment with you. Why is it that the way of wicked ones is what has succeeded, that all those who are committing treachery are the unworried ones?

19367.label: Jeremiah 12:2
19367.text: You have planted them; they have also taken root. They keep going ahead; they have also produced fruit. You are near in their mouth, but far away from their kidneys.

19368.label: Jeremiah 12:3
19368.text: And you yourself, O Jehovah, know me well; you see me, and you have examined my heart in union with yourself. Single them out like sheep for the slaughtering, and set them apart for the day of killing.

19369.label: Jeremiah 12:4
19369.text: How long should the land keep withering away, and the very vegetation of all the field dry up? Because of the badness of those dwelling in it the beasts and the flying creatures have been swept away. For they have said: “He does not see our future.”

19370.label: Jeremiah 12:5
19370.text: Because with footmen you have run, and they would tire you out, how, then, can you run a race with horses? And in the land of peace are you confident? So how will you act among the proud [thickets] along the Jordan?

19371.label: Jeremiah 12:6
19371.text: For even your own brothers and the household of your own father, even they themselves have dealt treacherously with you. Even they themselves have called out loudly behind you. Do not put any faith in them, just because they speak to you good things.

19372.label: Jeremiah 12:7
19372.text: “I have left my house; I have deserted my inheritance; I have given the beloved one of my soul into the palm of her enemies.

19373.label: Jeremiah 12:8
19373.text: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She has let loose her voice even against me. That is why I have hated her.

19374.label: Jeremiah 12:9
19374.text: My inheritance is as a many-colored bird of prey to me; the birds of prey are round about upon it. Come, gather together, all YOU wild beasts of the field; bring [them] to eat.

19375.label: Jeremiah 12:10
19375.text: Many shepherds themselves have brought my vineyard to ruin; they have stamped down my share. They have turned my desirable share into a wilderness of a desolate waste.

19376.label: Jeremiah 12:11
19376.text: One has made it a desolate waste; it has withered away; it is desolated to me. The whole land has been made desolate, because there is no man that has taken [it] to heart.

19377.label: Jeremiah 12:12
19377.text: On all the beaten paths through the wilderness the despoilers have come. For the sword belonging to Jehovah is devouring from one end of the land even to the other end of the land. There is no peace for any flesh.

19378.label: Jeremiah 12:13
19378.text: They have sown wheat, but thorns are what they have reaped. They have worked themselves sick; they will be of no benefit. And they will certainly be ashamed of the products of YOU people because of the burning anger of Jehovah.”

19379.label: Jeremiah 12:14
19379.text: This is what Jehovah has said against all my bad neighbors, who are touching the hereditary possession that I caused my people, even Israel, to possess: “Here I am uprooting them from off their ground; and the house of Judah I shall uproot from the midst of them.

19380.label: Jeremiah 12:15
19380.text: And it must occur that after my uprooting them I shall again certainly have mercy upon them and will bring them back, each one to his hereditary possession and each one to his land.”

19381.label: Jeremiah 12:16
19381.text: “And it must occur that if they will without fail learn the ways of my people in swearing by my name, ‘As Jehovah is alive!’ just as they taught my people to swear by Baʹal, they will also be built up in the midst of my people.

19382.label: Jeremiah 12:17
19382.text: But if they will not obey, I will also uproot that nation, uprooting and destroying [it],” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19383.label: Jeremiah 13:1
19383.text: This is what Jehovah has said to me: “Go, and you must get for yourself a linen belt and put it upon your hips, but you must not bring it into any water.”

19384.label: Jeremiah 13:2
19384.text: So I got the belt in accord with the word of Jehovah and put it upon my hips.

19385.label: Jeremiah 13:3
19385.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to me a second time, saying:

19386.label: Jeremiah 13:4
19386.text: “Take the belt that you got, that is upon your hips, and rise up, go to the Eu·phraʹtes, and hide it there in a cleft of the crag.”

19387.label: Jeremiah 13:5
19387.text: So I went and hid it by the Eu·phraʹtes, just as Jehovah had commanded me.

19388.label: Jeremiah 13:6
19388.text: But it came about at the end of many days that Jehovah proceeded to say to me: “Rise up, go to the Eu·phraʹtes and take from there the belt that I commanded you to hide there.”

19389.label: Jeremiah 13:7
19389.text: Accordingly I went to the Eu·phraʹtes and dug and took the belt from the place in which I had hid it, and, look! the belt had been ruined; it was not fit for anything.

19390.label: Jeremiah 13:8
19390.text: Then the word of Jehovah occurred to me, saying:

19391.label: Jeremiah 13:9
19391.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘In the same way I shall bring to ruin the pride of Judah and the abundant pride of Jerusalem.

19392.label: Jeremiah 13:10
19392.text: This bad people who are refusing to obey my words, who are walking in the stubbornness of their heart and who keep walking after other gods in order to serve them and to bow down to them, will also become just like this belt that is fit for nothing.’

19393.label: Jeremiah 13:11
19393.text: ‘For just as a belt clings to the hips of a man, so I caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling even to me,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘in order to become to me a people and a name and a praise and something beautiful; but they did not obey.’

19394.label: Jeremiah 13:12
19394.text: “And you must say to them this word, ‘This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said: “Every large jar is something that gets filled with wine.”’ And they will certainly say to you, ‘Do we not positively know that every large jar is something that gets filled with wine?’

19395.label: Jeremiah 13:13
19395.text: And you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am filling all the inhabitants of this land and the kings that are sitting for David upon his throne and the priests and the prophets and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with drunkenness.

19396.label: Jeremiah 13:14
19396.text: And I will dash them one against another, both the fathers and the sons, at the same time,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “I shall show no compassion, nor feel any sorrow, and I shall not have the mercy to keep from bringing them to ruin.”’

19397.label: Jeremiah 13:15
19397.text: “Hear, YOU people, and give ear. Do not be haughty, for Jehovah himself has spoken.

19398.label: Jeremiah 13:16
19398.text: Give to Jehovah YOUR God glory, before he causes darkness and before YOUR feet strike up against each other on the mountains at dusk. And YOU will certainly hope for the light, and he will actually make it deep shadow; he will turn [it] into thick gloom.

19399.label: Jeremiah 13:17
19399.text: And if YOU will not hear it, in places of concealment my soul will weep because of pride and will positively shed tears; and my eye will run down with tears, because the drove of Jehovah will have been carried captive.

19400.label: Jeremiah 13:18
19400.text: “Say to the king and to the lady, ‘Seat yourselves in a lower place, for down from YOUR heads YOUR crown of beauty will certainly come.’

19401.label: Jeremiah 13:19
19401.text: The cities of the south themselves have been shut up, so that there is no one opening [them]. Judah in its entirety has been taken into exile. It has been taken into exile completely.

19402.label: Jeremiah 13:20
19402.text: “Raise your eyes and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the drove that one gave to you, your beautiful flock?

19403.label: Jeremiah 13:21
19403.text: What will you say when one turns his attention upon you, when you yourself have taught them as confidential friends right alongside you at the start? Will not birth pangs themselves seize hold of you, like those of a wife giving birth?

19404.label: Jeremiah 13:22
19404.text: And when you will say in your heart, ‘Why is it that these things have befallen me?’ because of the abundance of your error your skirts have been taken off as a cover; your heels have been treated violently.

19405.label: Jeremiah 13:23
19405.text: “Can a Cushʹite change his skin? or a leopard its spots? YOU yourselves would also be able to do good, who are persons taught to do bad.

19406.label: Jeremiah 13:24
19406.text: So I shall scatter them like stubble that is passing along in the wind from the wilderness.

19407.label: Jeremiah 13:25
19407.text: This is your lot, your measured portion from me,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “because you have forgotten me and you keep putting your trust in falsehood.

19408.label: Jeremiah 13:26
19408.text: And I myself also will lift up your skirts over your face, and your dishonor will certainly be seen,

19409.label: Jeremiah 13:27
19409.text: your acts of adultery and your neighings, your loose conduct in prostitution. Upon the hills, in the field, I have seen your disgusting things. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! You cannot be clean —after how much longer?”

19410.label: Jeremiah 14:1
19410.text: [This is] what occurred as the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah concerning the matters of the droughts:

19411.label: Jeremiah 14:2
19411.text: Judah has gone mourning, and its very gates have faded away. They have become dejected to the earth, and even the outcry of Jerusalem has gone up.

19412.label: Jeremiah 14:3
19412.text: And their majestic ones themselves have sent their insignificant ones for water. They have come to the ditches. They have found no water. They have returned with their vessels empty. They have been put to shame and have been disappointed, and they have covered their head.

19413.label: Jeremiah 14:4
19413.text: On account of the soil that has been shattered because there has occurred no downpour upon the land, the farmers have become ashamed; they have covered their head.

19414.label: Jeremiah 14:5
19414.text: For even the hind in the field has given birth, but leaving [it], because there proved to be no tender grass.

19415.label: Jeremiah 14:6
19415.text: And the zebras themselves have stood still upon the bare hills; they have snuffed up the wind like the jackals; their eyes have failed because there is no vegetation.

19416.label: Jeremiah 14:7
19416.text: Even if our own errors do testify against us, O Jehovah, act for the sake of your name; for our acts of unfaithfulness have become many; it is against you that we have sinned.

19417.label: Jeremiah 14:8
19417.text: O you the hope of Israel, the Savior of him in the time of distress, why do you become like an alien resident in the land, and like a traveler that has turned aside to spend the night?

19418.label: Jeremiah 14:9
19418.text: Why do you become like a man astounded, like a mighty man that is unable to do any saving? Yet you yourself are in the midst of us, O Jehovah, and upon us it is that your own name has been called. Do not let us down.

19419.label: Jeremiah 14:10
19419.text: This is what Jehovah has said concerning this people: “Thus they have loved to wander about; their feet they have not kept in check. So Jehovah himself has taken no pleasure in them. Now he will remember their error and will give attention to their sins.”

19420.label: Jeremiah 14:11
19420.text: And Jehovah proceeded to say to me: “Do not pray in behalf of this people for any good.

19421.label: Jeremiah 14:12
19421.text: When they fast, I am not listening to their entreating cry; and when they offer up the whole burnt offering and the grain offering, I am taking no pleasure in them; for by the sword and by famine and by pestilence I am bringing them to their end.”

19422.label: Jeremiah 14:13
19422.text: At this I said: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Here the prophets are saying to them, ‘YOU will see no sword, and there will be no famine to happen to YOU, but true peace is what I shall give YOU in this place.’”

19423.label: Jeremiah 14:14
19423.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Falsehood is what the prophets are prophesying in my name. I have not sent them, nor have I commanded them or spoken to them.
