19768.text: ‘This is what Jehovah of armies has said: “Here I am sending against them the sword, the famine and the pestilence, and I will make them like the burst-open figs that cannot be eaten for badness.”’

19769.label: Jeremiah 29:18
19769.text: “‘And I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine and with the pestilence, and I will give them for a quaking to all the kingdoms of the earth, for a curse and for an object of astonishment and for a whistling at and for a reproach among all the nations to which I shall certainly disperse them,

19770.label: Jeremiah 29:19
19770.text: due to the fact that they have not listened to my words,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘that I have sent to them with my servants the prophets, getting up early and sending [them].’ “‘But YOU have not listened,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

19771.label: Jeremiah 29:20
19771.text: “And as for YOU, hear the word of Jehovah, all you exiled people, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

19772.label: Jeremiah 29:21
19772.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said concerning Aʹhab the son of Ko·laiʹah and to Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Ma·a·seiʹah, who are prophesying to YOU falsehood in my own name, ‘Here I am giving them into the hand of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon, and he must strike them down before YOUR eyes.

19773.label: Jeremiah 29:22
19773.text: And from them a malediction will certainly be taken on the part of the entire body of exiles of Judah that is in Babylon, saying: “May Jehovah make you like Zed·e·kiʹah and like Aʹhab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire!”

19774.label: Jeremiah 29:23
19774.text: for the reason that they have carried on senselessness in Israel, and they keep committing adultery with the wives of their companions and keep speaking falsely in my own name the word that I did not command them. “‘“And I am the One knowing and am a witness,” is the utterance of Jehovah.’”

19775.label: Jeremiah 29:24
19775.text: “And to She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam you will say,

19776.label: Jeremiah 29:25
19776.text: ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “For the reason that you yourself have sent in your name letters to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zeph·a·niʹah the son of Ma·a·seiʹah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

19777.label: Jeremiah 29:26
19777.text: ‘Jehovah himself has made you priest instead of Je·hoiʹa·da the priest, in order to become the grand overseer of the house of Jehovah toward any man maddened and behaving like a prophet, and you must put him into the stocks and into the pillory;

19778.label: Jeremiah 29:27
19778.text: now, then, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anʹa·thoth, who is behaving as a prophet to YOU people?

19779.label: Jeremiah 29:28
19779.text: For that is why he has sent to us at Babylon, saying: “It is long drawn out! Build houses and inhabit [them], and plant gardens and eat their fruitage, —”’”’”

19780.label: Jeremiah 29:29
19780.text: And Zeph·a·niʹah the priest proceeded to read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

19781.label: Jeremiah 29:30
19781.text: Then the word of Jehovah occurred to Jeremiah, saying:

19782.label: Jeremiah 29:31
19782.text: “Send to all the exiled people, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said concerning She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam: “For the reason that She·maiʹah has prophesied to YOU people, but I myself did not send him, and he tried to make YOU trust in falsehood,

19783.label: Jeremiah 29:32
19783.text: therefore this is what Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am turning my attention upon She·maiʹah of Ne·helʹam and upon his offspring.’ “‘“‘He will not come to have a man dwelling in the midst of this people; and he will not look upon the good that I am doing for my people,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘for he has spoken outright revolt against Jehovah.’”’”

19784.label: Jeremiah 30:1
19784.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19785.label: Jeremiah 30:2
19785.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘Write for yourself in a book all the words that I will speak to you.

19786.label: Jeremiah 30:3
19786.text: For, “look! there are days coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I will gather the captive ones of my people, Israel and Judah,” Jehovah has said, “and I will bring them back to the land that I gave to their forefathers, and they will certainly repossess it.”’”

19787.label: Jeremiah 30:4
19787.text: And these are the words that Jehovah has spoken to Israel and to Judah.

19788.label: Jeremiah 30:5
19788.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “The sound of trembling we have heard, dread, and there is no peace.

19789.label: Jeremiah 30:6
19789.text: Ask, please, O men, and see whether a male is giving birth. Why is it that I have seen every able-bodied man with his hands upon his loins like a female that is giving birth, and all faces have turned pale?

19790.label: Jeremiah 30:7
19790.text: Alas! For that day is a great one, so that there is no other like it, and it is the time of distress for Jacob. But he will be saved even out of it.”

19791.label: Jeremiah 30:8
19791.text: “And it must occur in that day,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies, “that I shall break one’s yoke from off your neck, and your bands I shall tear in two, and no more will strangers exploit him as a servant.

19792.label: Jeremiah 30:9
19792.text: And they will certainly serve Jehovah their God and David their king, whom I shall raise up for them.”

19793.label: Jeremiah 30:10
19793.text: “And as for you, do not be afraid, O my servant Jacob,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and do not be struck with terror, O Israel. For here I am saving you from far off and your offspring from the land of their captivity. And Jacob will certainly return and be free of disturbance and be at ease, and there will be no one causing trembling.”

19794.label: Jeremiah 30:11
19794.text: “For I am with you,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “to save you; but I shall make an extermination among all the nations to which I have scattered you. However, in your case I shall make no extermination. And I shall have to correct you to the proper degree, as I shall by no means leave you unpunished.”

19795.label: Jeremiah 30:12
19795.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “There is no cure for your breakdown. Your stroke is chronic.

19796.label: Jeremiah 30:13
19796.text: There is no one pleading your cause, for [your] ulcer. There are no means of healing, no mending, for you.

19797.label: Jeremiah 30:14
19797.text: All those intensely loving you are the ones that have forgotten you. You are not the one for whom they keep searching. For with the stroke of an enemy I have struck you, with the chastisement of someone cruel, on account of the abundance of your error; your sins have become numerous.

19798.label: Jeremiah 30:15
19798.text: Why do you cry out on account of your breakdown? Your pain is incurable on account of the abundance of your error; your sins have become numerous. I have done these things to you.

19799.label: Jeremiah 30:16
19799.text: Therefore all those devouring you will themselves be devoured; and as for all your adversaries, into captivity they will all of them go. And those pillaging you will certainly come to be for pillaging, and all those plundering you I shall give over to plundering.”

19800.label: Jeremiah 30:17
19800.text: “For I shall bring up a recuperation for you, and from your strokes I shall heal you,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “For a woman chased away is what they called you: ‘That is Zion, for whom no one is searching.’”

19801.label: Jeremiah 30:18
19801.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am gathering the captive ones of the tents of Jacob, and for his tabernacles I shall have pity. And the city will actually be rebuilt upon her mound; and upon its rightful site the dwelling tower itself will sit.

19802.label: Jeremiah 30:19
19802.text: And from them there will certainly go forth thanksgiving, and the sound of those who are laughing. And I will multiply them, and they will not become few; and I will make them heavy in number, and they will not become insignificant.

19803.label: Jeremiah 30:20
19803.text: And his sons must become as in former times, and before me his own assembly will be firmly established. And I will turn my attention upon all his oppressors.

19804.label: Jeremiah 30:21
19804.text: And his majestic one will certainly come to be from him, and from the midst of him his own ruler will go forth; and I will cause him to come near, and he must approach to me.” “For who, now, is this one that has given his heart in pledge in order to approach to me?” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19805.label: Jeremiah 30:22
19805.text: “And YOU will certainly become my people, and I myself shall become YOUR God.”

19806.label: Jeremiah 30:23
19806.text: Look! A windstorm of Jehovah, rage itself, has gone forth, an onward-sweeping tempest. Upon the head of the wicked ones it will whirl.

19807.label: Jeremiah 30:24
19807.text: The burning anger of Jehovah will not turn back until he will have executed and until he will have carried out the ideas of his heart. In the final part of the days YOU people will give YOUR consideration to it.

19808.label: Jeremiah 31:1
19808.text: “At that time,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “I shall become God to all the families of Israel; and as for them, they will become my people.”

19809.label: Jeremiah 31:2
19809.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “The people made up of survivors from the sword found favor in the wilderness, when Israel was walking to get his repose.”

19810.label: Jeremiah 31:3
19810.text: From far away Jehovah himself appeared to me, [saying:] “And with a love to time indefinite I have loved you. That is why I have drawn you with loving-kindness.

19811.label: Jeremiah 31:4
19811.text: Yet shall I rebuild you and you will actually be rebuilt, O virgin of Israel. You will yet deck yourself with your tambourines and actually go forth in the dance of those who are laughing.

19812.label: Jeremiah 31:5
19812.text: You will yet plant vineyards in the mountains of Sa·marʹi·a. The planters will certainly plant and start to use [them].

19813.label: Jeremiah 31:6
19813.text: For there exists a day when the lookouts in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im will actually call out, ‘Rise up, O men, and let us go up to Zion, to Jehovah our God.’”

19814.label: Jeremiah 31:7
19814.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “CRY out loudly to Jacob with rejoicing, and CRY shrilly at the head of nations. PUBLISH [it]. GIVE praise and SAY, ‘Save, O Jehovah, your people, the remnant of Israel.’

19815.label: Jeremiah 31:8
19815.text: Here I am bringing them from the land of the north, and I will collect them together from the remotest parts of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, the pregnant woman and the one giving birth, all together. As a great congregation they will return here.

19816.label: Jeremiah 31:9
19816.text: With weeping they will come, and with [their] entreaties for favor I shall bring them. I shall make them walk to torrent valleys of water, in a right way in which they will not be caused to stumble. For I have become to Israel a Father; and as for Eʹphra·im, he is my firstborn.”

19817.label: Jeremiah 31:10
19817.text: Hear the word of Jehovah, O YOU nations, and tell [it] among the islands far away, and say: “The One scattering Israel will himself collect him together, and he will certainly keep him as a shepherd does his drove.

19818.label: Jeremiah 31:11
19818.text: For Jehovah will actually redeem Jacob and reclaim him out of the hand of the one stronger than he is.

19819.label: Jeremiah 31:12
19819.text: And they will certainly come and cry out joyfully on the height of Zion and become radiant over the goodness of Jehovah, over the grain and over the new wine and over the oil and over the young ones of the flock and the cattle. And their soul will simply become like a well-watered garden, and no more will they languish again.”

19820.label: Jeremiah 31:13
19820.text: “At that time the virgin will rejoice in the dance, also the young men and the old men, all together. And I will change their mourning into exultation, and I will comfort them and make them rejoice away from their grief.

19821.label: Jeremiah 31:14
19821.text: And I will saturate the soul of the priests with fatness, and with my goodness my own people will become satisfied,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19822.label: Jeremiah 31:15
19822.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘In Raʹmah a voice is being heard, lamentation and bitter weeping; Rachel weeping over her sons. She has refused to be comforted over her sons, because they are no more.’”

19823.label: Jeremiah 31:16
19823.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “‘Hold back your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for there exists a reward for your activity,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and they will certainly return from the land of the enemy.’

19824.label: Jeremiah 31:17
19824.text: “‘And there exists a hope for your future,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and the sons will certainly return to their own territory.’”

19825.label: Jeremiah 31:18
19825.text: “I have positively heard Eʹphra·im bemoaning himself, ‘You have corrected me, that I may be corrected, like a calf that has not been trained. Cause me to turn back, and I shall readily turn back, for you are Jehovah my God.

19826.label: Jeremiah 31:19
19826.text: For after my turning back I felt regret; and after my being led to know I made a slap upon the thigh. I became ashamed, and I also felt humiliated, for I had carried the reproach of my youth.’”

19827.label: Jeremiah 31:20
19827.text: “Is Eʹphra·im a precious son to me, or a fondly treated child? For to the extent of my speaking against him I shall without fail remember him further. That is why my intestines have become boisterous for him. By all means I shall have pity upon him,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19828.label: Jeremiah 31:21
19828.text: “Set up road marks for yourself. Place signposts for yourself. Fix your heart upon the highway, the way that you will have to go. Come back, O virgin of Israel. Come back to these cities of yours.

19829.label: Jeremiah 31:22
19829.text: How long will you turn this way and that, O unfaithful daughter? For Jehovah has created a new thing in the earth: A mere female will press around an able-bodied man.”

19830.label: Jeremiah 31:23
19830.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “They will yet say this word in the land of Judah and in his cities, when I shall gather their captives, ‘May Jehovah bless you, O righteous dwelling place, O holy mountain.’

19831.label: Jeremiah 31:24
19831.text: And in it Judah and all his cities will certainly dwell all together, farmers and those who have set out with the drove.

19832.label: Jeremiah 31:25
19832.text: For I will saturate the tired soul, and every languishing soul I will fill.”

19833.label: Jeremiah 31:26
19833.text: At this thing I awoke and began to see; and as for my sleep, it had been pleasurable to me.

19834.label: Jeremiah 31:27
19834.text: “Look! There are days coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of domestic animal.”

19835.label: Jeremiah 31:28
19835.text: “And it must occur that just as I had kept alert toward them to uproot and to pull down and to tear down and to destroy and to do damage, so I shall keep alert toward them to build up and to plant,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19836.label: Jeremiah 31:29
19836.text: “In those days they will no more say, ‘The fathers were the ones that ate the unripe grape, but it was the teeth of the sons that got set on edge.’

19837.label: Jeremiah 31:30
19837.text: But it will be each one for his own error that one will die. Any man eating the unripe grape, his will be the teeth that will be set on edge.”

19838.label: Jeremiah 31:31
19838.text: “Look! There are days coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I will conclude with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant;

19839.label: Jeremiah 31:32
19839.text: not one like the covenant that I concluded with their forefathers in the day of my taking hold of their hand to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt, ‘which covenant of mine they themselves broke, although I myself had husbandly ownership of them,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19840.label: Jeremiah 31:33
19840.text: “For this is the covenant that I shall conclude with the house of Israel after those days,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “I will put my law within them, and in their heart I shall write it. And I will become their God, and they themselves will become my people.”

19841.label: Jeremiah 31:34
19841.text: “And they will no more teach each one his companion and each one his brother, saying, ‘KNOW Jehovah!’ for they will all of them know me, from the least one of them even to the greatest one of them,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “For I shall forgive their error, and their sin I shall remember no more.”

19842.label: Jeremiah 31:35
19842.text: This is what Jehovah, the Giver of the sun for light by day, the statutes of the moon and the stars for light by night, the One stirring up the sea that its waves may become boisterous, the One whose name is Jehovah of armies, has said:

19843.label: Jeremiah 31:36
19843.text: “‘If these regulations could be removed from before me,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘those who are the seed of Israel could likewise cease from proving to be a nation before me always.’”

19844.label: Jeremiah 31:37
19844.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “‘If the heavens up above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below could be searched out, I myself also could reject the entire seed of Israel on account of all that they have done,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19845.label: Jeremiah 31:38
19845.text: “Look! There are days coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and the city will certainly be built to Jehovah from the Tower of Ha·nanʹel to the Corner Gate.

19846.label: Jeremiah 31:39
19846.text: And the line for measurement will yet actually go forth straight ahead to the hill of Gaʹreb, and it will certainly go around to Goʹah.

19847.label: Jeremiah 31:40
19847.text: And all the low plain of the carcasses and of the fatty ashes, and all the terraces as far as the torrent valley of Kidʹron, clear to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the sunrising, will be something holy to Jehovah. It will not be uprooted, neither will it be torn down anymore to time indefinite.”

19848.label: Jeremiah 32:1
19848.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah in the tenth year of Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah, that is, the eighteenth year of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar.

19849.label: Jeremiah 32:2
19849.text: And at that time the military forces of the king of Babylon were laying siege to Jerusalem; and as for Jeremiah the prophet, he happened to be under restraint in the Courtyard of the Guard that is in the house of the king of Judah;

19850.label: Jeremiah 32:3
19850.text: because Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah had restrained him, saying: “Why is it that you are prophesying, saying, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will certainly capture it;

19851.label: Jeremiah 32:4
19851.text: and Zed·e·kiʹah himself, the king of Judah, will not escape from the hand of the Chal·deʹans, for he will without fail be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and his mouth will actually speak with the mouth of that one, and his own eyes will see even the eyes of that one”’;

19852.label: Jeremiah 32:5
19852.text: ‘and to Babylon he will take Zed·e·kiʹah, and there he will continue until I turn my attention to him,’ is the utterance of Jehovah; ‘although YOU men keep warring against the Chal·deʹans, YOU will not succeed’?”

19853.label: Jeremiah 32:6
19853.text: And Jeremiah proceeded to say: “The word of Jehovah has occurred to me, saying,

19854.label: Jeremiah 32:7
19854.text: ‘Here is Hanʹa·mel the son of Shalʹlum your paternal uncle coming in to you, saying: “Buy for yourself the field of mine that is in Anʹa·thoth, because the right of repurchase belongs to you for buying [it].”’”

19855.label: Jeremiah 32:8
19855.text: In time Hanʹa·mel the son of my paternal uncle came in to me, according to the word of Jehovah, into the Courtyard of the Guard, and proceeded to say to me: “Buy, please, the field of mine that is in Anʹa·thoth, which is in the land of Benjamin, for the right of hereditary possession is yours, and the repurchasing power is yours. Buy [it] for yourself.” At that I knew that it had been the word of Jehovah.

19856.label: Jeremiah 32:9
19856.text: So I proceeded to buy from Hanʹa·mel the son of my paternal uncle the field that was in Anʹa·thoth. And I began to weigh out to him the money, seven shekels and ten silver pieces.

19857.label: Jeremiah 32:10
19857.text: Then I wrote in a deed and affixed the seal and took witnesses as I went weighing the money in the scales.

19858.label: Jeremiah 32:11
19858.text: After that I took the deed of purchase, the one sealed according to the commandment and the regulations, and the one left open;

19859.label: Jeremiah 32:12
19859.text: and I then gave the deed of purchase to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah the son of Mah·seiʹah before the eyes of Hanʹa·mel [the son of] my paternal uncle and before the eyes of the witnesses, those writing in the deed of purchase, before the eyes of all the Jews who were sitting in the Courtyard of the Guard.

19860.label: Jeremiah 32:13
19860.text: I now commanded Barʹuch before their eyes, saying:

19861.label: Jeremiah 32:14
19861.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Taking these deeds, this deed of purchase, even the sealed one, and the other deed left open, you must also put them into an earthenware vessel, in order that they may last for many days.’

19862.label: Jeremiah 32:15
19862.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet be bought in this land.’”

19863.label: Jeremiah 32:16
19863.text: And I began to pray to Jehovah after my having given the deed of purchase to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah, saying:

19864.label: Jeremiah 32:17
19864.text: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! Here you yourself have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. The whole matter is not too wonderful for you yourself,

19865.label: Jeremiah 32:18
19865.text: the One exercising loving-kindness toward thousands, and repaying the error of the fathers into the bosom of their sons after them, the [true] God, the great One, the mighty One, Jehovah of armies being his name,

19866.label: Jeremiah 32:19
19866.text: great in counsel and abundant in acts, you whose eyes are opened upon all the ways of the sons of men, in order to give to each one according to his ways and according to the fruitage of his dealings;

19867.label: Jeremiah 32:20
19867.text: you who set signs and miracles in the land of Egypt down to this day and in Israel and among men, that you might make a name for your own self, just as at this day.

19868.label: Jeremiah 32:21
19868.text: And you proceeded to bring forth your people Israel out of the land of Egypt, with signs and with miracles and with a strong hand and with a stretched-out arm and with great fearsomeness.

19869.label: Jeremiah 32:22
19869.text: “In time you gave them this land that you swore to their forefathers to give to them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

19870.label: Jeremiah 32:23
19870.text: And they proceeded to come in and take possession of it, but they did not obey your voice, and in your law they did not walk. All the things that you commanded them to do they did not do, so that you caused all this calamity to befall them.

19871.label: Jeremiah 32:24
19871.text: Look! With siege ramparts men have come to the city to capture it, and the very city will certainly be given into the hand of the Chal·deʹans who are fighting against it, because of the sword and the famine and the pestilence; and what you have said has happened, and here you are seeing [it].

19872.label: Jeremiah 32:25
19872.text: Yet you yourself have said to me, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘Buy for yourself the field with money and take witnesses,’ although the city itself must be given into the hand of the Chal·deʹans.”

19873.label: Jeremiah 32:26
19873.text: At that the word of Jehovah occurred to Jeremiah, saying:

19874.label: Jeremiah 32:27
19874.text: “Here I am, Jehovah, the God of all flesh. For me is there any matter at all too wonderful?

19875.label: Jeremiah 32:28
19875.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am giving this city into the hand of the Chal·deʹans and into the hand of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon, and he must capture it.

19876.label: Jeremiah 32:29
19876.text: And the Chal·deʹans who are fighting against this city must come in and set this city aflame with fire and must burn it down and the houses upon the roofs of which they have made sacrificial smoke to Baʹal and have poured out drink offerings to other gods for the purpose of offending me.’

19877.label: Jeremiah 32:30
19877.text: “‘For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have proved to be mere doers of what was bad in my eyes, from their youth on up; for the sons of Israel are even offending me by the work of their hands,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

19878.label: Jeremiah 32:31
19878.text: ‘For this city, from the day that they built it, clear down to this day, has proved to be nothing but a cause of anger in me and a cause of rage in me, in order to remove it from before my face,

19879.label: Jeremiah 32:32
19879.text: on account of all the badness of the sons of Israel and of the sons of Judah that they have done to offend me, they, their kings, their princes, their priests and their prophets, and the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

19880.label: Jeremiah 32:33
19880.text: And they kept turning to me the back and not the face; though there was a teaching of them, a rising up early and teaching, but there were none of them listening to receive discipline.

19881.label: Jeremiah 32:34
19881.text: And they went putting their disgusting things in the house upon which my own name has been called, in order to defile it.

19882.label: Jeremiah 32:35
19882.text: Furthermore, they built the high places of Baʹal that are in the valley of the son of Hinʹnom, in order to make their sons and their daughters pass through [the fire] to Moʹlech, a thing that I did not command them, neither did it come up into my heart to do this detestable thing, for the purpose of making Judah sin.’

19883.label: Jeremiah 32:36
19883.text: “And now, therefore, this is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said concerning this city which YOU persons are saying will certainly be given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword and by the famine and by the pestilence,

19884.label: Jeremiah 32:37
19884.text: ‘Here I am collecting them together out of all the lands to which I shall have dispersed them in my anger and in my rage and in great indignation; and I will bring them back to this place and make them dwell in security.

19885.label: Jeremiah 32:38
19885.text: And they will certainly become my people, and I myself shall become their God.

19886.label: Jeremiah 32:39
19886.text: And I will give them one heart and one way in order to fear me always, for good to them and to their sons after them.

19887.label: Jeremiah 32:40
19887.text: And I will conclude with them an indefinitely lasting covenant, that I shall not turn back from behind them, for me to do them good; and the fear of me I shall put in their heart in order not to turn aside from me.

19888.label: Jeremiah 32:41
19888.text: And I will exult over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land in trueness with all my heart and with all my soul.’”

19889.label: Jeremiah 32:42
19889.text: “For this is what Jehovah has said, ‘Just as I have brought in upon this people all this great calamity, so I am bringing in upon them all the goodness that I am speaking concerning them.

19890.label: Jeremiah 32:43
19890.text: And fields will certainly be bought in this land of which YOU people will be saying: “It is a desolate waste without man and domestic animal. It has been given into the hand of the Chal·deʹans.”’

19891.label: Jeremiah 32:44
19891.text: “‘With money people will buy fields themselves, and there will be a recording in the deed and a sealing and a taking of witnesses in the land of Benjamin and in the surroundings of Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah and in the cities of the mountainous region and in the cities of the lowland and in the cities of the south, because I shall bring back their captives,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

19892.label: Jeremiah 33:1
19892.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the Courtyard of the Guard, saying:

19893.label: Jeremiah 33:2
19893.text: “This is what Jehovah the Maker of [earth] has said, Jehovah the Former of it to establish it firmly, Jehovah being his name,

19894.label: Jeremiah 33:3
19894.text: ‘Call to me, and I shall answer you and readily tell you great and incomprehensible things that you have not known.’”

19895.label: Jeremiah 33:4
19895.text: “For this is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah that are pulled down on account of the siege ramparts and on account of the sword;

19896.label: Jeremiah 33:5
19896.text: [concerning] those who are coming to fight against the Chal·deʹans and to fill places with the carcasses of the men whom I have struck down in my anger and in my rage, and on account of all whose badness I have concealed my face from this city,

19897.label: Jeremiah 33:6
19897.text: ‘Here I am bringing up for her a recuperation and health; and I will heal them and reveal to them an abundance of peace and truth.

19898.label: Jeremiah 33:7
19898.text: And I will bring back the captives of Judah and the captives of Israel, and I will build them just as at the start.

19899.label: Jeremiah 33:8
19899.text: And I will purify them from all their error with which they have sinned against me, and I will forgive all their errors with which they have sinned against me and with which they have transgressed against me.

19900.label: Jeremiah 33:9
19900.text: And she will certainly become to me a name of exultation, a praise and a beauty toward all the nations of the earth who will hear of all the goodness that I am rendering to them. And they will certainly be in dread and be agitated on account of all the goodness and on account of all the peace that I am rendering to her.’”

19901.label: Jeremiah 33:10
19901.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘In this place that YOU people will be saying is waste without man and without domestic animal, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are desolated without man and without inhabitant and without domestic animal, there will yet be heard

19902.label: Jeremiah 33:11
19902.text: the sound of exultation and the sound of rejoicing, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those saying: “LAUD Jehovah of armies, for Jehovah is good; for to time indefinite is his loving-kindness!”’ “‘They will be bringing a thanksgiving offering into the house of Jehovah, for I shall bring back the captives of the land just as at the start,’ Jehovah has said.”

19903.label: Jeremiah 33:12
19903.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies has said, ‘In this waste place without man and even domestic animal and in all its cities there will yet come to be the pasture ground of the shepherds who are making the flock lie down.’

19904.label: Jeremiah 33:13
19904.text: “‘In the cities of the mountainous region, in the cities of the lowland and in the cities of the south and in the land of Benjamin and in the surroundings of Jerusalem and in the cities of Judah flocks will yet pass by under the hands of the one taking the count,’ Jehovah has said.”

19905.label: Jeremiah 33:14
19905.text: “‘Look! There are days coming,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I shall certainly carry out the good word that I have spoken, concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

19906.label: Jeremiah 33:15
19906.text: In those days and at that time I shall make sprout for David a righteous sprout, and he will certainly execute justice and righteousness in the land.

19907.label: Jeremiah 33:16
19907.text: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem itself will reside in security. And this is what she will be called, Jehovah Is Our Righteousness.’”

19908.label: Jeremiah 33:17
19908.text: “For this is what Jehovah has said, ‘There will not be cut off in David’s case a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel.

19909.label: Jeremiah 33:18
19909.text: And in the case of the priests, the Levites, there will not be cut off a man from before me to offer up whole burnt offering and to make smoke with a grain offering and to render sacrifice always.’”

19910.label: Jeremiah 33:19
19910.text: And the word of Jehovah came further to Jeremiah, saying:

19911.label: Jeremiah 33:20
19911.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘If YOU people could break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, even in order for day and night not to occur in their time,

19912.label: Jeremiah 33:21
19912.text: likewise could my own covenant be broken with David my servant so that he should not come to have a son ruling as king upon his throne; also with the Levites, the priests, my ministers.

19913.label: Jeremiah 33:22
19913.text: Just as the army of the heavens cannot be counted, neither the sand of the sea be measured, so I shall multiply the seed of David my servant and the Levites who are ministering to me.’”

19914.label: Jeremiah 33:23
19914.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to Jeremiah, saying:

19915.label: Jeremiah 33:24
19915.text: “Have you not seen what those of this people have spoken, saying, ‘The two families whom Jehovah has chosen, he will also reject them’? And my own people they keep treating with disrespect, so that it should no more continue being a nation before them.

19916.label: Jeremiah 33:25
19916.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘If it was not a fact that I had appointed my own covenant of the day and night, the statutes of heaven and earth,

19917.label: Jeremiah 33:26
19917.text: so too I would reject even the seed of Jacob and of David my servant, so that I should not take from his seed rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I shall gather their captives and will have pity upon them.’”

19918.label: Jeremiah 34:1
19918.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, when Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon and all his military force and all the kingdoms of the earth, the dominion under his hand, and all the peoples were fighting against Jerusalem and against all her cities, saying:

19919.label: Jeremiah 34:2
19919.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘Go, and you must say to Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah, yes, you must say to him: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he must burn it with fire.

19920.label: Jeremiah 34:3
19920.text: And you yourself will not escape out of his hand, because you will without fail be caught and into his hand you will be given. And your own eyes will see even the eyes of the king of Babylon, and his own mouth will speak even with your mouth, and to Babylon you will come.’

19921.label: Jeremiah 34:4
19921.text: However, hear the word of Jehovah, O Zed·e·kiʹah king of Judah, ‘This is what Jehovah has said concerning you: “You will not die by the sword.

19922.label: Jeremiah 34:5
19922.text: In peace you will die; and as with the burnings for your fathers, the former kings who happened to be prior to you, so they will make a burning for you, and ‘Alas, O master!’ is what they will say in lament for you, for ‘I myself have spoken the very word,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”’”’”

19923.label: Jeremiah 34:6
19923.text: And Jeremiah the prophet proceeded to speak to Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah all these words in Jerusalem,

19924.label: Jeremiah 34:7
19924.text: when the military forces of the king of Babylon were fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left remaining, against Laʹchish and against A·zeʹkah; for they, the fortified cities, were the ones that remained over among the cities of Judah.

19925.label: Jeremiah 34:8
19925.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah after King Zed·e·kiʹah concluded a covenant with all the people who were in Jerusalem to proclaim to them liberty,

19926.label: Jeremiah 34:9
19926.text: to let each one his manservant and each one his maidservant, Hebrew man and Hebrew woman, go free, in order not to use them as servants, that is, a Jew, who is his brother.

19927.label: Jeremiah 34:10
19927.text: So all the princes obeyed, and all the people who had entered into the covenant to let each one his manservant and each one his maidservant go free, in order to use them no more as servants, and they proceeded to obey and to let [them] go.

19928.label: Jeremiah 34:11
19928.text: But they turned about after that and began to bring back the menservants and the maidservants whom they had let go free, and they went subjecting them as menservants and as maidservants.

19929.label: Jeremiah 34:12
19929.text: Consequently the word of Jehovah occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19930.label: Jeremiah 34:13
19930.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘I myself concluded a covenant with YOUR forefathers in the day of my bringing them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of servants, saying:

19931.label: Jeremiah 34:14
19931.text: “At the end of seven years YOU men should let go each one his brother, a Hebrew man, who came to be sold to you and who has served you six years; and you must let him go free from being with you.” But YOUR forefathers did not listen to me, neither did they incline their ear.

19932.label: Jeremiah 34:15
19932.text: And YOU yourselves turn around today and do what is upright in my eyes in proclaiming liberty each one to his companion, and YOU conclude a covenant before me in the house upon which my name has been called.

19933.label: Jeremiah 34:16
19933.text: Then YOU turn back and profane my name and bring back each one his manservant and each one his maidservant, whom YOU let go free agreeably to their soul, and YOU subject them to become YOUR menservants and maidservants.’

19934.label: Jeremiah 34:17
19934.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah has said, ‘YOU yourselves have not obeyed me in keeping on proclaiming liberty each one to his brother and each one to his companion. Here I am proclaiming to YOU a liberty,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘to the sword, to the pestilence and to the famine, and I shall certainly give YOU for a quaking to all the kingdoms of the earth.

19935.label: Jeremiah 34:18
19935.text: And I will give the men sidestepping my covenant, in that they did not carry out the words of the covenant that they concluded before me [with] the calf that they cut in two that they might pass between its pieces;

19936.label: Jeremiah 34:19
19936.text: [namely,] the princes of Judah and the princes of Jerusalem, the court officials and the priests and all the people of the land who went passing between the pieces of the calf—

19937.label: Jeremiah 34:20
19937.text: yes, I will give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those seeking for their soul; and their dead bodies must become food for the flying creatures of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth.

19938.label: Jeremiah 34:21
19938.text: And Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah and his princes I shall give into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those seeking for their soul and into the hand of the military forces of the king of Babylon who are withdrawing from against YOU men.’

19939.label: Jeremiah 34:22
19939.text: “‘Here I am commanding,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I shall certainly bring them back to this city, and they must fight against it and capture it and burn it with fire; and the cities of Judah I shall make a desolate waste without an inhabitant.’”

19940.label: Jeremiah 35:1
19940.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah in the days of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, saying:

19941.label: Jeremiah 35:2
19941.text: “Go to the house of the Reʹcha·bites, and you must speak with them and bring them into the house of Jehovah, to one of the dining rooms; and you must give them wine to drink.”

19942.label: Jeremiah 35:3
19942.text: So I took Ja·az·a·niʹah the son of Jeremiah the son of Hab·az·zi·niʹah and his brothers, and all his sons, and all the household of the Reʹcha·bites,

19943.label: Jeremiah 35:4
19943.text: and I proceeded to bring them into the house of Jehovah, to the dining room of the sons of Haʹnan the son of Ig·da·liʹah, a man of the [true] God, which was beside the dining room of the princes that was above the dining room of Ma·a·seiʹah the son of Shalʹlum the doorkeeper.

19944.label: Jeremiah 35:5
19944.text: Then I put before the sons of the house of the Reʹcha·bites cups full of wine and goblets and said to them: “Drink wine.”

19945.label: Jeremiah 35:6
19945.text: But they said: “We shall drink no wine, because Jonʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab, our forefather, was the one that laid the command upon us, saying, ‘YOU must drink no wine, neither YOU nor YOUR sons, to time indefinite.

19946.label: Jeremiah 35:7
19946.text: And no house must YOU build, and no seed must YOU sow; and no vineyard must YOU plant, nor must it come to be YOURS. But in tents YOU should dwell all YOUR days, in order that YOU may keep living many days upon the surface of the ground where YOU are residing as aliens.’

19947.label: Jeremiah 35:8
19947.text: So we keep obeying the voice of Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab our forefather in everything that he commanded us by drinking no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons and our daughters,

19948.label: Jeremiah 35:9
19948.text: and by not building houses for us to dwell in, so that no vineyard or field or seed should become ours.

19949.label: Jeremiah 35:10
19949.text: And we keep dwelling in tents and obeying and doing according to all that Jonʹa·dab our forefather commanded us.

19950.label: Jeremiah 35:11
19950.text: But it came about when Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon came up against the land that we began to say, ‘Come, and let us enter into Jerusalem because of the military force of the Chal·deʹans and because of the military force of the Syrians, and let us dwell in Jerusalem.’”

19951.label: Jeremiah 35:12
19951.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to Jeremiah, saying:

19952.label: Jeremiah 35:13
19952.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Go, and you must say to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: “Did YOU not continually receive exhortation to obey my words?” is the utterance of Jehovah.

19953.label: Jeremiah 35:14
19953.text: “There has been a carrying out of the words of Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab, that he commanded his sons, to drink no wine, and they have drunk none down to this day, because they have obeyed the commandment of their forefather. And as for me, I have spoken to YOU men, rising up early and speaking, but YOU have not obeyed me.

19954.label: Jeremiah 35:15
19954.text: And I kept sending to YOU all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending [them], saying, ‘Turn back, please, each one from his bad way, and make YOUR dealings good, and do not walk after other gods to serve them. And keep dwelling on the ground that I have given to YOU and to YOUR forefathers.’ But YOU did not incline YOUR ear, nor did YOU listen to me.

19955.label: Jeremiah 35:16
19955.text: But the sons of Je·honʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab have carried out the commandment of their forefather that he commanded them; but as for this people, they have not listened to me.”’”

19956.label: Jeremiah 35:17
19956.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Here I am bringing upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the calamity that I have spoken against them, for the reason that I have spoken to them but they did not listen, and I kept calling to them but they did not answer.’”

19957.label: Jeremiah 35:18
19957.text: And to the household of the Reʹcha·bites Jeremiah said: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘For the reason that YOU have obeyed the commandment of Je·honʹa·dab YOUR forefather and continue keeping all his commandments and doing according to all that he commanded YOU,

19958.label: Jeremiah 35:19
19958.text: therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “There will not be cut off from Jonʹa·dab the son of Reʹchab a man to stand before me always.”’”

19959.label: Jeremiah 36:1
19959.text: Now it came about in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, that this word occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

19960.label: Jeremiah 36:2
19960.text: “Take for yourself a roll of a book, and you must write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel and against Judah and against all the nations, since the day that I spoke to you, since the days of Jo·siʹah, clear down to this day.

19961.label: Jeremiah 36:3
19961.text: Perhaps those of the house of Judah will listen to all the calamity that I am thinking of doing to them, to the end that they may return, each one from his bad way, and that I may actually forgive their error and their sin.”

19962.label: Jeremiah 36:4
19962.text: And Jeremiah proceeded to call Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah that Barʹuch might write at the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Jehovah that He had spoken to him, on the roll of the book.

19963.label: Jeremiah 36:5
19963.text: Then Jeremiah commanded Barʹuch, saying: “I am shut up. I am unable to enter into the house of Jehovah.

19964.label: Jeremiah 36:6
19964.text: And you yourself must enter in and read aloud from the roll that you have written at my mouth the words of Jehovah in the ears of the people at the house of Jehovah in the day of fast; and also in the ears of all Judah who are coming in from their cities you should read them aloud.

19965.label: Jeremiah 36:7
19965.text: Perhaps their request for favor will fall before Jehovah and they will return, each one from his bad way, for great is the anger and the rage that Jehovah has spoken against this people.”

19966.label: Jeremiah 36:8
19966.text: And Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah proceeded to do according to all that Jeremiah the prophet had commanded him, to read aloud from the book the words of Jehovah at the house of Jehovah.

19967.label: Jeremiah 36:9
19967.text: Now it came about in the fifth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, in the ninth month, that all the people in Jerusalem and all the people that were coming in from the cities of Judah into Jerusalem proclaimed a fast before Jehovah.

19968.label: Jeremiah 36:10
19968.text: And Barʹuch began to read aloud from the book the words of Jeremiah at the house of Jehovah, in the dining room of Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan the copyist, in the upper courtyard, at the entrance of the new gate of the house of Jehovah, in the ears of all the people.

19969.label: Jeremiah 36:11
19969.text: And Mi·caiʹah the son of Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan got to hear all the words of Jehovah from out of the book.

19970.label: Jeremiah 36:12
19970.text: At that he went down to the house of the king, to the dining room of the secretary, and, look! there is where all the princes were sitting, E·lishʹa·ma the secretary and De·laʹiah the son of She·maiʹah and El·naʹthan the son of Achʹbor and Gem·a·riʹah the son of Shaʹphan and Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Han·a·niʹah and all the other princes.

19971.label: Jeremiah 36:13
19971.text: And Mi·caiʹah proceeded to tell them all the words that he had heard when Barʹuch read aloud from the book in the ears of the people.

19972.label: Jeremiah 36:14
19972.text: Then all the princes sent out to Barʹuch Je·huʹdi the son of Neth·a·niʹah the son of Shel·e·miʹah the son of Cushʹi, saying: “The roll from which you read aloud in the ears of the people—take it in your hand and come.” Accordingly Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah took the roll in his hand and came in to them.

19973.label: Jeremiah 36:15
19973.text: Then they said to him: “Sit down, please, and read it aloud in our ears.” So Barʹuch read aloud in their ears.

19974.label: Jeremiah 36:16
19974.text: Now it came about that as soon as they heard all the words, they looked at one another in dread; and they proceeded to say to Barʹuch: “We shall without fail tell the king all these words.”

19975.label: Jeremiah 36:17
19975.text: And Barʹuch they asked, saying: “Tell us, please, How did you write all these words from his mouth?”

19976.label: Jeremiah 36:18
19976.text: Then Barʹuch said to them: “Out of his mouth he kept declaring to me all these words, and I was writing in the book with ink.”

19977.label: Jeremiah 36:19
19977.text: Finally the princes said to Barʹuch: “Go, conceal yourself, you and Jeremiah, so that no one at all will know where YOU men are.”

19978.label: Jeremiah 36:20
19978.text: Then they came in to the king, to the courtyard, and the roll they entrusted to the dining room of E·lishʹa·ma the secretary; and they began to tell all the words in the ears of the king.

19979.label: Jeremiah 36:21
19979.text: So the king sent Je·huʹdi out to get the roll. Accordingly he got it out of the dining room of E·lishʹa·ma the secretary. And Je·huʹdi began to read it aloud in the ears of the king and in the ears of all the princes standing by the king.

19980.label: Jeremiah 36:22
19980.text: And the king was sitting in the winter house, in the ninth month, with a brazier burning before him.

19981.label: Jeremiah 36:23
19981.text: Then it came about that as soon as Je·huʹdi had read three or four page-columns, he proceeded to tear it apart with the secretary’s knife, pitching [it] also into the fire that was in the brazier until all the roll ended up in the fire that was in the brazier.

19982.label: Jeremiah 36:24
19982.text: And they felt no dread; neither did the king and all his servants, who were listening to all these words, rip their garments apart.

19983.label: Jeremiah 36:25
19983.text: And even El·naʹthan and De·laʹiah and Gem·a·riʹah themselves pleaded with the king not to burn the roll, but he did not listen to them.

19984.label: Jeremiah 36:26
19984.text: Further, the king commanded Je·rahʹme·el the son of the king and Se·raiʹah the son of Azʹri·el and Shel·e·miʹah the son of Abʹde·el to get Barʹuch the secretary and Jeremiah the prophet. But Jehovah kept them concealed.

19985.label: Jeremiah 36:27
19985.text: And the word of Jehovah occurred further to Jeremiah after the king had burned up the roll with the words that Barʹuch had written at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying:

19986.label: Jeremiah 36:28
19986.text: “Take again for yourself a roll, another one, and write on it all the first words that proved to be on the first roll, which Je·hoiʹa·kim the king of Judah burned up.

19987.label: Jeremiah 36:29
19987.text: And against Je·hoiʹa·kim the king of Judah you should say, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “You yourself have burned up this roll, saying, ‘Why is it that you have written on it, saying: “The king of Babylon will come without fail and will certainly bring this land to ruin and cause man and beast to cease from it”?’

19988.label: Jeremiah 36:30
19988.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said against Je·hoiʹa·kim the king of Judah, ‘He will come to have no one sitting upon the throne of David, and his own dead body will become something thrown out to the heat by day and to the frost by night.

19989.label: Jeremiah 36:31
19989.text: And I will call to account against him and against his offspring and against his servants their error, and I will bring upon them and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem and upon the men of Judah all the calamity that I have spoken against them, and they did not listen.’”’”

19990.label: Jeremiah 36:32
19990.text: And Jeremiah himself took another roll and then gave it to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah, the secretary, who proceeded to write upon it at the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book that Je·hoiʹa·kim the king of Judah had burned in the fire; and there were added to them many more words like those.

19991.label: Jeremiah 37:1
19991.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah the son of Jo·siʹah began to reign in place of Co·niʹah the son of Je·hoiʹa·kim, whom Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

19992.label: Jeremiah 37:2
19992.text: And he himself and his servants and the people of the land did not listen to the words of Jehovah that he spoke by means of Jeremiah the prophet.

19993.label: Jeremiah 37:3
19993.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah proceeded to send Je·huʹcal the son of Shel·e·miʹah and Zeph·a·niʹah the son of Ma·a·seiʹah the priest to Jeremiah the prophet, saying: “Pray, please, in our behalf to Jehovah our God.”

19994.label: Jeremiah 37:4
19994.text: And Jeremiah was coming in and going out into the midst of the people, as they had not put him in the house of detention.

19995.label: Jeremiah 37:5
19995.text: And there was a military force of Pharʹaoh that came out of Egypt; and the Chal·deʹans that were laying siege to Jerusalem got to hear the report about them. So they withdrew from against Jerusalem.

19996.label: Jeremiah 37:6
19996.text: Then the word of Jehovah occurred to Jeremiah the prophet, saying:

19997.label: Jeremiah 37:7
19997.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘This is what YOU men should say to the king of Judah, the one sending YOU to me to inquire of me: “Look! The military force of Pharʹaoh that is coming forth to YOU people for the purpose of assistance will have to go back to their land, Egypt.

19998.label: Jeremiah 37:8
19998.text: And the Chal·deʹans will certainly come back and fight against this city and capture it and burn it with fire.”

19999.label: Jeremiah 37:9
19999.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Do not deceive YOUR souls, saying, ‘The Chal·deʹans will without fail go away from against us,’ because they will not go away.

20000.label: Jeremiah 37:10
20000.text: For if YOU men had struck down all the military force of the Chal·deʹans who are fighting YOU and there remained over among them men pierced through, they would each one in his tent rise up and actually burn this city with fire.”’”

20001.label: Jeremiah 37:11
20001.text: And it occurred when the military force of the Chal·deʹans had withdrawn themselves from against Jerusalem because of the military force of Pharʹaoh,

20002.label: Jeremiah 37:12
20002.text: that Jeremiah began to go forth from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin and to get [his] portion from there in the midst of the people.

20003.label: Jeremiah 37:13
20003.text: So it came about when he was in the Gate of Benjamin that the officer holding the oversight, whose name was I·riʹjah the son of Shel·e·miʹah the son of Han·a·niʹah, was there. At once he took hold of Jeremiah the prophet, saying: “It is to the Chal·deʹans that you are falling away!”

20004.label: Jeremiah 37:14
20004.text: But Jeremiah said: “It is false! I am not falling away to the Chal·deʹans.” But he did not listen to him. So I·riʹjah kept hold of Jeremiah and brought him in to the princes.

20005.label: Jeremiah 37:15
20005.text: And the princes began to get indignant at Jeremiah, and they struck him and put him into the house of fetters, in the house of Je·honʹa·than the secretary, for this was what they had made the house of detention.

20006.label: Jeremiah 37:16
20006.text: When Jeremiah came into the house of the cistern and into the vaulted rooms, then Jeremiah continued dwelling there many days.

20007.label: Jeremiah 37:17
20007.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah proceeded to send and take him, and the king began asking him questions in his house in a place of concealment. And he went on to say: “Does there exist a word from Jehovah?” To this Jeremiah said: “There does exist!” And he said further: “Into the hand of the king of Babylon you will be given!”

20008.label: Jeremiah 37:18
20008.text: Then Jeremiah said to King Zed·e·kiʹah: “In what way have I sinned against you and against your servants and against this people, so that YOU men have put me into the house of detention?

20009.label: Jeremiah 37:19
20009.text: Where, now, are YOUR prophets who prophesied to YOU, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against YOU men and against this land’?

20010.label: Jeremiah 37:20
20010.text: And now listen, please, O my lord the king. May my request for favor, please, fall before you, and do not send me back to the house of Je·honʹa·than the secretary, that I may not die there.”

20011.label: Jeremiah 37:21
20011.text: Accordingly King Zed·e·kiʹah commanded, and they then put Jeremiah in custody in the Courtyard of the Guard; and there was a giving of a round loaf of bread to him daily from the street of the bakers, until all the bread was exhausted from the city. And Jeremiah continued dwelling in the Courtyard of the Guard.

20012.label: Jeremiah 38:1
20012.text: And Sheph·a·tiʹah the son of Matʹtan and Ged·a·liʹah the son of Pashʹhur and Juʹcal the son of Shel·e·miʹah and Pashʹhur the son of Mal·chiʹjah got to hear the words that Jeremiah was speaking to all the people, saying:

20013.label: Jeremiah 38:2
20013.text: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘The one continuing to dwell in this city is the one that will die by the sword, by the famine and by the pestilence. But the one going out to the Chal·deʹans is the one that will keep living and that will certainly come to have his soul as a spoil and alive.’

20014.label: Jeremiah 38:3
20014.text: This is what Jehovah has said, ‘Without fail this city will be given into the hand of the military force of the king of Babylon, and he will certainly capture it.’”

20015.label: Jeremiah 38:4
20015.text: And the princes began to say to the king: “Let this man, please, be put to death, for that is how he is weakening the hands of the men of war who are left remaining in this city and the hands of all the people, by speaking to them according to these words. For this man is one seeking not for the peace of this people but for calamity.”

20016.label: Jeremiah 38:5
20016.text: So King Zed·e·kiʹah said: “Look! He is in YOUR hands. For there is nothing at all in which the king himself can prevail against YOU.”

20017.label: Jeremiah 38:6
20017.text: And they proceeded to take Jeremiah and throw him into the cistern of Mal·chiʹjah the son of the king, which was in the Courtyard of the Guard. So they let Jeremiah down by means of ropes. Now in the cistern there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah began to sink down into the mire.

20018.label: Jeremiah 38:7
20018.text: And Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an, a man who was a eunuch and who was in the house of the king, got to hear that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern; and the king was sitting in the Gate of Benjamin.

20019.label: Jeremiah 38:8
20019.text: So Eʹbed-melʹech went out of the house of the king and spoke to the king, saying:

20020.label: Jeremiah 38:9
20020.text: “O my lord the king, these men have done bad in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have thrown into the cistern, so that he will die where he is because of the famine. For there is no bread anymore in the city.”

20021.label: Jeremiah 38:10
20021.text: Then the king commanded Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an, saying: “Take in your charge from this place thirty men, and you must get Jeremiah the prophet up out of the cistern before he dies.”

20022.label: Jeremiah 38:11
20022.text: Accordingly Eʹbed-melʹech took the men in his charge and went into the house of the king to beneath the treasury and took from there worn-out rags and worn-out pieces of cloth and let them down to Jeremiah into the cistern by means of the ropes.

20023.label: Jeremiah 38:12
20023.text: Then Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an said to Jeremiah: “Put, please, the worn-out rags and the pieces of cloth under your armpits beneath the ropes.” Jeremiah now did so.

20024.label: Jeremiah 38:13
20024.text: Finally they drew out Jeremiah by means of the ropes and brought him up out of the cistern. And Jeremiah continued to dwell in the Courtyard of the Guard.

20025.label: Jeremiah 38:14
20025.text: And King Zed·e·kiʹah proceeded to send and take Jeremiah the prophet to him to the third entryway, which is in the house of Jehovah, and then the king said to Jeremiah: “I am asking something of you. Do not hide from me anything.”

20026.label: Jeremiah 38:15
20026.text: At this Jeremiah said to Zed·e·kiʹah: “In case I should tell you, will you not without fail put me to death? And in case I advise you, you will not listen to me.”

20027.label: Jeremiah 38:16
20027.text: At that King Zed·e·kiʹah swore to Jeremiah in the place of concealment, saying: “As Jehovah is alive, who has made for us this soul, I will not put you to death, and I will not give you into the hand of these men who are seeking for your soul.”

20028.label: Jeremiah 38:17
20028.text: Jeremiah now said to Zed·e·kiʹah: “This is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘If you will without fail go out to the princes of the king of Babylon, your soul will also certainly keep living and this city itself will not be burned with fire, and you yourself and your household will certainly keep living.

20029.label: Jeremiah 38:18
20029.text: But if you will not go out to the princes of the king of Babylon, this city must also be given into the hand of the Chal·deʹans, and they will actually burn it with fire, and you yourself will not escape out of their hand.’”

20030.label: Jeremiah 38:19
20030.text: Then King Zed·e·kiʹah said to Jeremiah: “I am in fright of the Jews that have fallen away to the Chal·deʹans, for fear that they might give me into their hand and they might actually deal abusively with me.”

20031.label: Jeremiah 38:20
20031.text: But Jeremiah said: “They will do no such giving. Obey, please, the voice of Jehovah in what I am speaking to you, and it will go well with you, and your soul will continue to live.

20032.label: Jeremiah 38:21
20032.text: But if you are refusing to go out, this is the thing that Jehovah has caused me to see:

20033.label: Jeremiah 38:22
20033.text: And, look! all the women that have been left remaining in the house of the king of Judah are being brought out to the princes of the king of Babylon, and they are saying, ‘The men at peace with you have allured you and prevailed over you. They have caused your foot to sink down into the very ooze; they have retreated in the opposite direction.’

20034.label: Jeremiah 38:23
20034.text: And all your wives and your sons they are bringing out to the Chal·deʹans, and you yourself will not escape out of their hand, but by the hand of the king of Babylon you will be seized, and because of you this city will be burned with fire.”

20035.label: Jeremiah 38:24
20035.text: And Zed·e·kiʹah proceeded to say to Jeremiah: “May no man at all get to know about these things, so that you do not die.

20036.label: Jeremiah 38:25
20036.text: And in case the princes hear that I have spoken with you and they actually come in to you and say to you, ‘Do tell us, please, What did you speak about to the king? Do not hide anything from us, and we shall not put you to death. And what did the king speak about to you?’

20037.label: Jeremiah 38:26
20037.text: you must also say to them, ‘I was letting my request for favor fall before the king, that he should not send me back to the house of Je·honʹa·than to die there.’”

20038.label: Jeremiah 38:27
20038.text: In time all the princes came in to Jeremiah and began questioning him. In turn, he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they became silent before him, for the matter was not heard.

20039.label: Jeremiah 38:28
20039.text: And Jeremiah continued to dwell in the Courtyard of the Guard until the day that Jerusalem was captured. And it occurred just when Jerusalem was captured.

20040.label: Jeremiah 39:1
20040.text: In the ninth year of Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah, in the tenth month, Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon and all his military force came to Jerusalem and began to lay siege to it.

20041.label: Jeremiah 39:2
20041.text: In the eleventh year of Zed·e·kiʹah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the city was broken through.

20042.label: Jeremiah 39:3
20042.text: And all the princes of the king of Babylon proceeded to come in and sit down in the Middle Gate, [namely,] Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer, Samʹgar-neʹbo, Sarʹse·chim, Rabʹsa·ris, Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer the Rabʹmag and all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

20043.label: Jeremiah 39:4
20043.text: Now it came about that as soon as Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, they began to run away and to go out by night from the city by the way of the garden of the king, by the gate between the double wall; and they kept going out by the way of the Arʹa·bah.

20044.label: Jeremiah 39:5
20044.text: And a military force of the Chal·deʹans went chasing after them, and they got to overtake Zed·e·kiʹah in the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho. Then they took him and brought him up to Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon at Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath that he might pronounce upon him judicial decisions.

20045.label: Jeremiah 39:6
20045.text: And the king of Babylon proceeded to slaughter the sons of Zed·e·kiʹah in Ribʹlah before his eyes, and all the nobles of Judah the king of Babylon slaughtered.

20046.label: Jeremiah 39:7
20046.text: And the eyes of Zed·e·kiʹah he blinded, after which he bound him with copper fetters, in order to bring him to Babylon.

20047.label: Jeremiah 39:8
20047.text: And the house of the king and the houses of the people the Chal·deʹans burned with fire, and the walls of Jerusalem they pulled down.

20048.label: Jeremiah 39:9
20048.text: And the rest of the people who were left remaining in the city, and the deserters that had fallen away to him, and the rest of the people who were left remaining Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard took into exile to Babylon.

20049.label: Jeremiah 39:10
20049.text: And some of the people, the lowly ones who had nothing at all, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard let remain in the land of Judah; and he went on to give them vineyards and compulsory services on that day.

20050.label: Jeremiah 39:11
20050.text: Furthermore, Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon gave command concerning Jeremiah by means of Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard, saying:

20051.label: Jeremiah 39:12
20051.text: “Take him and keep your own eyes set upon him, and do not do to him anything bad at all. But just as he may speak to you, so do with him.”

20052.label: Jeremiah 39:13
20052.text: Accordingly Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard and Neb·u·shazʹban the Rabʹsa·ris, and Nerʹgal-shar·eʹzer the Rabʹmag and all the principal men of the king of Babylon sent;

20053.label: Jeremiah 39:14
20053.text: they even proceeded to send and take Jeremiah out of the Courtyard of the Guard and give him over to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan, in order to bring him forth to [his] house, that he might dwell in the midst of the people.

20054.label: Jeremiah 39:15
20054.text: And to Jeremiah the word of Jehovah occurred while he happened to be shut up in the Courtyard of the Guard, saying:

20055.label: Jeremiah 39:16
20055.text: “Go, and you must say to Eʹbed-melʹech the E·thi·oʹpi·an, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “Here I am bringing true my words upon this city for calamity and not for good, and they will certainly happen before you in that day.”’

20056.label: Jeremiah 39:17
20056.text: “‘And I will deliver you in that day,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you yourself are scared.’

20057.label: Jeremiah 39:18
20057.text: “‘For I shall without fail furnish you an escape, and by the sword you will not fall; and you will certainly come to have your soul as a spoil, because you have trusted in me,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

20058.label: Jeremiah 40:1
20058.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah from Jehovah after Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard sent him from Raʹmah, when he took him while he was bound with handcuffs in the midst of all the exiles of Jerusalem and of Judah, who were being taken into exile in Babylon.

20059.label: Jeremiah 40:2
20059.text: Then the chief of the bodyguard took Jeremiah and said to him: “Jehovah your God himself spoke this calamity against this place,

20060.label: Jeremiah 40:3
20060.text: that Jehovah might bring [it] true and do just as he has spoken, because YOU people have sinned against Jehovah and have not obeyed his voice. And this thing has happened to YOU.

20061.label: Jeremiah 40:4
20061.text: And now, look! I have let you loose today from the handcuffs that were upon your hands. If it is good in your eyes to come with me to Babylon, come, and I shall keep my eye upon you. But if it is bad in your eyes to come with me to Babylon, refrain. See! The entire land is before you. To wherever it is good and right in your eyes to go, go there.”

20062.label: Jeremiah 40:5
20062.text: And he was yet not one that would return, when [Neb·uʹzar·adʹan said]: “Do return to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan, whom the king of Babylon has commissioned over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him in the midst of the people; or to wherever it is right in your eyes to go, go.” And the chief of the bodyguard then gave him a food allowance and a present and let him go.

20063.label: Jeremiah 40:6
20063.text: Accordingly Jeremiah came to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam at Mizʹpah and took up dwelling with him in the midst of the people who were left remaining in the land.

20064.label: Jeremiah 40:7
20064.text: In time all the chiefs of the military forces who were in the field, they and their men, got to hear that the king of Babylon had commissioned Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam over the land and that he had commissioned him [over] the men and women and little children and some of the lowly people of the land, who had not been taken into exile in Babylon.

20065.label: Jeremiah 40:8
20065.text: So they came to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah, even Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and Jo·haʹnan and Jonʹa·than, the sons of Ka·reʹah, and Se·raiʹah the son of Tan·huʹmeth and the sons of Eʹphai the Ne·tophʹa·thite and Jez·a·niʹah the son of the Ma·acʹa·thite, they and their men.

20066.label: Jeremiah 40:9
20066.text: And Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan proceeded to swear to them and to their men, saying: “Do not be afraid of serving the Chal·deʹans. Continue dwelling in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with YOU.

20067.label: Jeremiah 40:10
20067.text: And as for me, here I am dwelling in Mizʹpah, in order to stand before the Chal·deʹans who will come to us. And as for YOU yourselves, gather wine and summer fruits and oil and put [them] in YOUR vessels and dwell in YOUR cities that YOU have seized.”

20068.label: Jeremiah 40:11
20068.text: And all the Jews that were in Moʹab and among the sons of Amʹmon and in Eʹdom and those who were in all the [other] lands, they also heard that the king of Babylon had given a remnant to Judah and that he had commissioned over them Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan.

20069.label: Jeremiah 40:12
20069.text: And all the Jews began to return from all the places to which they had been dispersed, and they kept coming into the land of Judah to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah. And they went gathering wine and summer fruits in very great quantity.

20070.label: Jeremiah 40:13
20070.text: As for Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces who were in the field, they came to Ged·a·liʹah at Mizʹpah.

20071.label: Jeremiah 40:14
20071.text: And they proceeded to say to him: “Do you not at all know that Baʹa·lis, the king of the sons of Amʹmon, himself has sent Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah to strike you to the soul?” But Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam did not believe them.

20072.label: Jeremiah 40:15
20072.text: And Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah himself said to Ged·a·liʹah, in a place of concealment in Mizʹpah: “I want to go, now, and strike down Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, as no one at all will know. Why should he strike you to the soul, and why must all those of Judah who are being collected together to you be scattered and the remnant of Judah perish?”

20073.label: Jeremiah 40:16
20073.text: But Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam said to Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah: “Do not do this thing, for it is a falsehood that you are speaking concerning Ishʹma·el.”

20074.label: Jeremiah 41:1
20074.text: So it came about in the seventh month that Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah the son of E·lishʹa·ma of the royal offspring and [of the] principal men of the king and ten other men with him came to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam at Mizʹpah. And there they began to eat bread together in Mizʹpah.

20075.label: Jeremiah 41:2
20075.text: Then Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and the ten men that happened to be with him rose up and struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan with the sword. So he put to death the one whom the king of Babylon had commissioned over the land.

20076.label: Jeremiah 41:3
20076.text: And all the Jews who happened to be with him, that is, with Ged·a·liʹah, in Mizʹpah, and the Chal·deʹans who were found there, that is, the men of war, Ishʹma·el struck down.

20077.label: Jeremiah 41:4
20077.text: And it came about on the second day of the putting of Ged·a·liʹah to death, when there was no one at all that knew [it],

20078.label: Jeremiah 41:5
20078.text: then there came men from Sheʹchem, from Shiʹloh and from Sa·marʹi·a, eighty men with their beards shaved off and with their garments ripped apart and with cuts made upon themselves, and there were grain offering and frankincense in their hand to bring to the house of Jehovah.

20079.label: Jeremiah 41:6
20079.text: So Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah went out from Mizʹpah to meet them, weeping while he was walking along. And it came about that as soon as he encountered them he proceeded to say to them: “Come to Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam.”

20080.label: Jeremiah 41:7
20080.text: But it occurred that as soon as they came into the midst of the city, Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah went slaughtering them [and throwing them] into the midst of the cistern, he and the men that were with him.

20081.label: Jeremiah 41:8
20081.text: But there were ten men that were found among them who immediately said to Ishʹma·el: “Do not put us to death, for there exist in our possession hidden treasures in the field, wheat and barley and oil and honey.” So he refrained, and he did not put them to death in the midst of their brothers.

20082.label: Jeremiah 41:9
20082.text: Now the cistern into which Ishʹma·el threw all the carcasses of the men that he had struck down was a great cistern, the one that King Aʹsa had made because of Baʹa·sha the king of Israel. It was the one that Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah filled with those slain.

20083.label: Jeremiah 41:10
20083.text: Then Ishʹma·el took captive all the remnant of the people who were in Mizʹpah, the daughters of the king and all the people who were remaining over in Mizʹpah, whom Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard had put in the custody of Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam. So Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah took them captive and went off to cross over to the sons of Amʹmon.

20084.label: Jeremiah 41:11
20084.text: In time Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces who were with him got to hear all the bad that Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah had done.

20085.label: Jeremiah 41:12
20085.text: Consequently they took all the men and went off to fight against Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah and found him by the abundant waters that were in Gibʹe·on.

20086.label: Jeremiah 41:13
20086.text: Then it came about that as soon as all the people that were with Ishʹma·el saw Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces who were with him, they began to rejoice.

20087.label: Jeremiah 41:14
20087.text: And all the people whom Ishʹma·el had led captive from Mizʹpah proceeded to turn around and return and go to Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah.

20088.label: Jeremiah 41:15
20088.text: And as for Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, he escaped with eight men from before Jo·haʹnan, that he might go to the sons of Amʹmon.

20089.label: Jeremiah 41:16
20089.text: Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces who were with him now took all the remnant of the people whom they brought back from Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah, from Mizʹpah, after he had struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam, able-bodied men, men of war, and the wives and the little children and the court officials, whom he brought back from Gibʹe·on.

20090.label: Jeremiah 41:17
20090.text: So they went and took up dwelling in the lodging place of Chimʹham that was beside Bethʹle·hem, in order to go on and enter into Egypt,

20091.label: Jeremiah 41:18
20091.text: because of the Chal·deʹans; for they had become afraid because of them, since Ishʹma·el the son of Neth·a·niʹah had struck down Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam, whom the king of Babylon had commissioned over the land.

20092.label: Jeremiah 42:1
20092.text: Then all the chiefs of the military forces and Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and Jez·a·niʹah the son of Ho·shaiʹah and all the people, from the smallest one even to the greatest one, approached

20093.label: Jeremiah 42:2
20093.text: and said to Jeremiah the prophet: “May our request for favor, please, fall before you, and do you pray in our behalf to Jehovah your God, in behalf of all this remnant, for we have been left remaining, a few out of many, just as your eyes are seeing us.

20094.label: Jeremiah 42:3
20094.text: And may Jehovah your God tell us the way in which we should walk and the thing that we should do.”

20095.label: Jeremiah 42:4
20095.text: At that Jeremiah the prophet said to them: “I have heard. Here I am praying to Jehovah YOUR God according to YOUR words; and it will certainly occur that every word that Jehovah gives in answer to YOU I shall tell YOU. I shall not hold back from YOU a word.”

20096.label: Jeremiah 42:5
