20096.text: And they, for their part, said to Jeremiah: “May Jehovah prove to be a true and faithful witness against us if it is not according to every word with which Jehovah your God sends you to us that we shall exactly do.

20097.label: Jeremiah 42:6
20097.text: Whether good or bad, it is the voice of Jehovah our God to whom we are sending you that we shall obey, to the intent that it may go well with us because we obey the voice of Jehovah our God.”

20098.label: Jeremiah 42:7
20098.text: Now it came about at the end of ten days that the word of Jehovah proceeded to occur to Jeremiah.

20099.label: Jeremiah 42:8
20099.text: So he called for Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and for all the chiefs of the military forces who were with him and for all the people, from the smallest one even to the greatest one;

20100.label: Jeremiah 42:9
20100.text: and he went on to say to them: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel, to whom YOU sent me to cause your request for favor to fall before him, has said,

20101.label: Jeremiah 42:10
20101.text: ‘If YOU will without fail keep dwelling in this land, I will also build YOU up and I shall not tear [YOU] down, and I will plant YOU and I shall not uproot [YOU]; for I shall certainly feel regret over the calamity that I have caused to YOU.

20102.label: Jeremiah 42:11
20102.text: Do not be afraid because of the king of Babylon, of whom YOU are in fear.’ “‘Do not be afraid because of him,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘for I am with YOU, in order to save YOU and to deliver YOU out of his hand.

20103.label: Jeremiah 42:12
20103.text: And I shall give to YOU mercies, and he will certainly have mercy upon YOU and return YOU to YOUR own soil.

20104.label: Jeremiah 42:13
20104.text: “‘But if YOU are saying: “No; we are not going to dwell in this land!” in order to disobey the voice of Jehovah YOUR God,

20105.label: Jeremiah 42:14
20105.text: saying: “No, but into the land of Egypt we shall enter, where we shall see no war and the sound of the horn we shall not hear and for bread we shall not go hungry; and there is where we shall dwell”;

20106.label: Jeremiah 42:15
20106.text: even now therefore hear the word of Jehovah, O remnant of Judah. This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “If YOU yourselves positively set YOUR faces to enter into Egypt and YOU actually enter in to reside there as aliens,

20107.label: Jeremiah 42:16
20107.text: it must also occur that the very sword of which YOU are afraid will there catch up with YOU in the land of Egypt, and the very famine at which YOU are in a fright will there closely follow after YOU to Egypt; and there is where YOU will die.

20108.label: Jeremiah 42:17
20108.text: And it will come about that all the men that have set their faces to enter into Egypt to reside there as aliens will be the ones to die by the sword, by the famine and by the pestilence; and they will not come to have a survivor or an escapee, because of the calamity that I am bringing in upon them.”’

20109.label: Jeremiah 42:18
20109.text: “For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Just as my anger and my rage have been poured out upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my rage will be poured out upon YOU because of YOUR entering into Egypt, and YOU will certainly become a curse and an object of astonishment and a malediction and a reproach, and you will no more see this place.’

20110.label: Jeremiah 42:19
20110.text: “Jehovah has spoken against YOU, O remnant of Judah. Do not enter into Egypt. YOU should positively know that I have borne witness against YOU today,

20111.label: Jeremiah 42:20
20111.text: that YOU have committed error against YOUR souls; for YOU yourselves have sent me to Jehovah YOUR God, saying, ‘Pray in our behalf to Jehovah our God; and according to everything that Jehovah our God says tell us that way, and we shall certainly do.’

20112.label: Jeremiah 42:21
20112.text: And I tell YOU today, but YOU will certainly not obey the voice of Jehovah YOUR God or anything with which he has sent me to YOU.

20113.label: Jeremiah 42:22
20113.text: And now YOU should positively know that by the sword, by the famine and by the pestilence YOU will die in the place into which YOU do delight to enter to reside as aliens.”

20114.label: Jeremiah 43:1
20114.text: Now it came about that as soon as Jeremiah finished speaking to all the people all the words of Jehovah their God with which Jehovah their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

20115.label: Jeremiah 43:2
20115.text: Az·a·riʹah the son of Ho·shaiʹah and Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the presumptuous men proceeded to say to Jeremiah: “It is a falsehood that you are speaking. Jehovah our God has not sent you, saying, ‘Do not enter into Egypt to reside there as aliens.’

20116.label: Jeremiah 43:3
20116.text: But Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah is instigating you against us for the purpose of giving us into the hand of the Chal·deʹans, to put us to death or to take us into exile in Babylon.”

20117.label: Jeremiah 43:4
20117.text: And Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces and all the people did not obey the voice of Jehovah, to keep on dwelling in the land of Judah.

20118.label: Jeremiah 43:5
20118.text: So Jo·haʹnan the son of Ka·reʹah and all the chiefs of the military forces took all the remnant of Judah that had returned from all the nations to which they had been dispersed, in order to reside for a while in the land of Judah,

20119.label: Jeremiah 43:6
20119.text: even the able-bodied men and the wives and the little children and the daughters of the king and every soul that Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard had let stay with Ged·a·liʹah the son of A·hiʹkam the son of Shaʹphan, and Jeremiah the prophet and Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah.

20120.label: Jeremiah 43:7
20120.text: And they finally came into the land of Egypt, for they did not obey the voice of Jehovah; and they came gradually as far as Tahʹpan·hes.

20121.label: Jeremiah 43:8
20121.text: Then the word of Jehovah occurred to Jeremiah in Tahʹpan·hes, saying:

20122.label: Jeremiah 43:9
20122.text: “Take in your hand great stones, and you must hide them in the mortar in the terrace of bricks that is at the entrance of the house of Pharʹaoh in Tahʹpan·hes before the eyes of the Jewish men.

20123.label: Jeremiah 43:10
20123.text: And you must say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “Here I am sending and I will take Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and I will place his throne right above these stones that I have hidden, and he will certainly extend his state tent over them.

20124.label: Jeremiah 43:11
20124.text: And he must come in and strike the land of Egypt. Whoever is [due] for deadly plague will be for deadly plague, and whoever is [due] for captivity will be for captivity, and whoever is [due] for the sword will be for the sword.

20125.label: Jeremiah 43:12
20125.text: And I will set a fire ablaze in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he will certainly burn them and lead them captive and wrap himself up in the land of Egypt, just as a shepherd wraps himself up in his garment, and he will actually go out from there in peace.

20126.label: Jeremiah 43:13
20126.text: And he will certainly break to pieces the pillars of Beth-sheʹmesh, which is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of Egypt he will burn with fire.”’”

20127.label: Jeremiah 44:1
20127.text: The word that occurred to Jeremiah for all the Jews that were dwelling in the land of Egypt, the ones dwelling in Migʹdol and in Tahʹpan·hes and in Noph and in the land of Pathʹros, saying:

20128.label: Jeremiah 44:2
20128.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘YOU yourselves have seen all the calamity that I have brought in upon Jerusalem and upon all the cities of Judah, and here they are a devastated place this day, and in them there is no inhabitant.

20129.label: Jeremiah 44:3
20129.text: It is because of their badness that they did in order to offend me by going and making sacrificial smoke and rendering service to other gods whom they themselves had not known, neither YOU nor YOUR forefathers.

20130.label: Jeremiah 44:4
20130.text: And I kept sending to YOU all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending, saying: “Do not do, please, this detestable sort of thing that I have hated.”

20131.label: Jeremiah 44:5
20131.text: But they did not listen, nor did they incline their ear to turn back from their badness by not making sacrificial smoke to other gods.

20132.label: Jeremiah 44:6
20132.text: So my rage, and my anger, was poured out and it burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they came to be a devastated place, a desolate waste, as at this day.’

20133.label: Jeremiah 44:7
20133.text: “And now this is what Jehovah, the God of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Why are YOU causing a great calamity to YOUR souls, in order to cut off from yourselves man and woman, child and suckling, out of the midst of Judah, so that YOU do not leave over for yourselves a remnant;

20134.label: Jeremiah 44:8
20134.text: by offending me with the works of YOUR hands by making sacrificial smoke to other gods in the land of Egypt, into which YOU are entering to reside as aliens; for the purpose of causing a cutting off of yourselves and for the purpose of YOUR becoming a malediction and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

20135.label: Jeremiah 44:9
20135.text: Have YOU forgotten the bad deeds of YOUR forefathers and the bad deeds of the kings of Judah and the bad deeds of their wives and YOUR own bad deeds and the bad deeds of YOUR wives, that they have done in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

20136.label: Jeremiah 44:10
20136.text: And down to this day they did not feel crushed, and they did not become afraid, nor did they walk in my law and in my statutes that I put before YOU and before YOUR forefathers.’

20137.label: Jeremiah 44:11
20137.text: “Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Here I am setting my face against YOU for calamity and for cutting off all Judah.

20138.label: Jeremiah 44:12
20138.text: And I will take the remnant of Judah who set their faces to enter into the land of Egypt to reside there as aliens, and they will all certainly come to their finish in the land of Egypt. They will fall by the sword; [and] by the famine they will come to their finish, from the smallest one even to the greatest one; by the sword and by the famine they will die. And they must become a curse, an object of astonishment and a malediction and a reproach.

20139.label: Jeremiah 44:13
20139.text: And I will hold an accounting against those dwelling in the land of Egypt, just as I held an accounting against Jerusalem, with the sword, with the famine and with the pestilence.

20140.label: Jeremiah 44:14
20140.text: And there will come to be no escapee or survivor for the remnant of Judah who are entering in to reside there as aliens, in the land of Egypt, even to return to the land of Judah to which they are lifting up their soul[ful desire] to return in order to dwell; for they will not return, except some escaped ones.’”

20141.label: Jeremiah 44:15
20141.text: And all the men who were knowing that their wives had been making sacrificial smoke to other gods, and all the wives who were standing as a great congregation, and all the people who were dwelling in the land of Egypt, in Pathʹros, proceeded to answer Jeremiah, saying:

20142.label: Jeremiah 44:16
20142.text: “As regards the word that you have spoken to us in the name of Jehovah, we are not listening to you;

20143.label: Jeremiah 44:17
20143.text: but we shall positively do every word that has gone forth from our mouth, in order to make sacrificial smoke to the ‘queen of the heavens’ and to pour out to her drink offerings, just as we ourselves and our forefathers, our kings and our princes did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, when we used to be satisfied with bread and to be well off, and we did not see any calamity at all.

20144.label: Jeremiah 44:18
20144.text: And from the time that we ceased to make sacrificial smoke to the ‘queen of the heavens’ and pour out drink offerings to her we have lacked everything, and by the sword and by the famine we have come to our finish.

20145.label: Jeremiah 44:19
20145.text: “Also, when we were making sacrificial smoke to the ‘queen of the heavens’ and [were disposed] to pour out drink offerings to her, did we without asking our husbands make for her sacrificial cakes, in order to make an image of her, and to pour out drink offerings to her?”

20146.label: Jeremiah 44:20
20146.text: In turn Jeremiah said to all the people, to the able-bodied men and to the wives and to all the people, who were answering him with a word, saying:

20147.label: Jeremiah 44:21
20147.text: “As for the sacrificial smoke that YOU made in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, YOU and YOUR forefathers, YOUR kings and YOUR princes and the people of the land, was it not this that Jehovah remembered and that proceeded to come up into his heart?

20148.label: Jeremiah 44:22
20148.text: Finally Jehovah was no longer able to put up with it because of the badness of YOUR dealings, because of the detestable things that YOU had done, and so YOUR land came to be a devastated place and an object of astonishment and a malediction, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

20149.label: Jeremiah 44:23
20149.text: Because of the fact that YOU made sacrificial smoke and that YOU sinned against Jehovah and did not obey the voice of Jehovah and in his law and in his statutes and in his reminders YOU did not walk, that is why there has befallen YOU this calamity as at this day.”

20150.label: Jeremiah 44:24
20150.text: And Jeremiah continued on to say to all the people and to all the women: “Hear the word of Jehovah, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt.

20151.label: Jeremiah 44:25
20151.text: This is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘As for YOU men and YOUR wives, YOU women also speak with YOUR mouths, (and with YOUR hands YOU people have made a fulfillment,) saying: “We shall without fail perform our vows that we have vowed, to make sacrificial smoke to the ‘queen of the heavens’ and to pour out drink offerings to her.” YOU women will without fail carry out YOUR vows, and YOU will without fail perform YOUR vows.’

20152.label: Jeremiah 44:26
20152.text: “Therefore hear the word of Jehovah, all Judah who are dwelling in the land of Egypt, ‘“Here I myself have sworn by my great name,” Jehovah has said, “that my name will no more prove to be something called out by the mouth of any man of Judah, saying, ‘As the Sovereign Lord Jehovah is alive!’ in all the land of Egypt.

20153.label: Jeremiah 44:27
20153.text: Here I am keeping alert toward them for calamity and not for good; and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt will certainly come to their finish by the sword and by the famine, until they cease to be.

20154.label: Jeremiah 44:28
20154.text: And as for the ones escaping from the sword, they will return from the land of Egypt to the land of Judah, few in number; and all those of the remnant of Judah, who are coming into the land of Egypt to reside there as aliens, will certainly know whose word comes true, that from me or that from them.”’”

20155.label: Jeremiah 44:29
20155.text: “‘And this is the sign for YOU,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘that I am turning my attention upon YOU in this place, in order that YOU may know that my words will without fail come true upon YOU for calamity:

20156.label: Jeremiah 44:30
20156.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am giving Pharʹaoh Hophʹra, the king of Egypt, into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those seeking for his soul, just as I have given Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah into the hand of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon, his enemy and the one seeking for his soul.”’”

20157.label: Jeremiah 45:1
20157.text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Barʹuch the son of Ne·riʹah when he wrote in a book these words from the mouth of Jeremiah in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah, saying:

20158.label: Jeremiah 45:2
20158.text: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said concerning you, O Barʹuch,

20159.label: Jeremiah 45:3
20159.text: ‘You have said: “Woe, now, to me, for Jehovah has added grief to my pain! I have grown weary because of my sighing, and no resting-place have I found.”’

20160.label: Jeremiah 45:4
20160.text: “This is what you should say to him, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Look! What I have built up I am tearing down, and what I have planted I am uprooting, even all the land itself.

20161.label: Jeremiah 45:5
20161.text: But as for you, you keep seeking great things for yourself. Do not keep on seeking.”’ “‘For here I am bringing in a calamity upon all flesh,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I will give you your soul as a spoil in all the places to which you may go.’”

20162.label: Jeremiah 46:1
20162.text: This is what occurred as the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

20163.label: Jeremiah 46:2
20163.text: For Egypt, concerning the military force of Pharʹaoh Neʹcho the king of Egypt, who happened to be by the river Eu·phraʹtes at Carʹche·mish, whom Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Je·hoiʹa·kim the son of Jo·siʹah, the king of Judah:

20164.label: Jeremiah 46:3
20164.text: “Set in array, O men, buckler and large shield, and approach to battle.

20165.label: Jeremiah 46:4
20165.text: Harness the horses, and mount, O YOU horsemen, and station yourselves with the helmet. Polish the lances. Clothe yourselves with coats of mail.

20166.label: Jeremiah 46:5
20166.text: “‘Why is it that I have seen them terror-stricken? They are turning back, and their mighty men themselves are crushed to pieces; and they have positively fled, and they have not turned around. There is fright all around,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20167.label: Jeremiah 46:6
20167.text: ‘Let not the swift one try to flee, and let not the mighty man try to escape. Up north by the bank of the river Eu·phraʹtes they have stumbled and fallen.’

20168.label: Jeremiah 46:7
20168.text: “Who is this one that comes up just like the Nile River, like the rivers the waters of which toss themselves?

20169.label: Jeremiah 46:8
20169.text: Egypt itself comes up just like the Nile River, and like rivers the waters toss themselves. And it says, ‘I shall go up. I shall cover the earth. I shall readily destroy the city and those inhabiting it.’

20170.label: Jeremiah 46:9
20170.text: Go up, O YOU horses; and drive madly, O YOU chariots! And let the mighty men go forth, Cush and Put, who are handling the shield, and the Luʹdim, who are handling [and] treading the bow.

20171.label: Jeremiah 46:10
20171.text: “And that day belongs to the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, the day of vengeance for avenging himself upon his adversaries. And the sword will certainly devour and satisfy itself and take its fill of their blood, for the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, has a sacrifice in the land of the north by the river Eu·phraʹtes.

20172.label: Jeremiah 46:11
20172.text: “Go up to Gilʹe·ad and get some balsam, O virgin daughter of Egypt. In vain you have multiplied the means of healing. There is no mending for you.

20173.label: Jeremiah 46:12
20173.text: The nations have heard your dishonor and your own outcry has filled the land. For they have stumbled, mighty man against mighty man. Together they have fallen down, both of them.”

20174.label: Jeremiah 46:13
20174.text: The word that Jehovah spoke to Jeremiah the prophet as regards the coming of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon to strike down the land of Egypt:

20175.label: Jeremiah 46:14
20175.text: “Tell [it] in Egypt, O men, and publish [it] in Migʹdol, and publish [it] in Noph and in Tahʹpan·hes. Say, ‘Station yourself, making preparation also for yourself, for a sword will certainly devour all around you.

20176.label: Jeremiah 46:15
20176.text: Why is it that your powerful ones have been washed away? They have made no stand, for Jehovah himself has pushed them away.

20177.label: Jeremiah 46:16
20177.text: In great numbers they are stumbling. They also actually fall. And they keep saying one to the other: “Do rise up, and do let us return to our people and to the land of our relatives because of the maltreating sword.”’

20178.label: Jeremiah 46:17
20178.text: There they have proclaimed, ‘Pharʹaoh the king of Egypt is a mere noise. He has let the festal time pass by.’

20179.label: Jeremiah 46:18
20179.text: “‘As I am alive,’ is the utterance of the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies, ‘like Taʹbor among the mountains and like Carʹmel by the sea he will come in.

20180.label: Jeremiah 46:19
20180.text: Make for yourself mere baggage for exile, O inhabitress, the daughter of Egypt. For Noph itself will become a mere object of astonishment and will actually be set afire, so as to be without an inhabitant.

20181.label: Jeremiah 46:20
20181.text: Egypt is as a very pretty heifer. From the north a mosquito itself will certainly come against her.

20182.label: Jeremiah 46:21
20182.text: Furthermore, her hired [soldiers] in the midst of her are like fattened calves. But they themselves also have given way; they have fled together. They have not made a stand. For the very day of their disaster has come in upon them, the time of their being given attention.’

20183.label: Jeremiah 46:22
20183.text: “‘Her voice is like that of a serpent that goes along; for with vital energy men will go, and with axes they will actually come in to her, like those who are gathering pieces of wood.

20184.label: Jeremiah 46:23
20184.text: They will certainly cut down her forest,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘for it could not be penetrated. For they have become more numerous than the locust, and they are without number.

20185.label: Jeremiah 46:24
20185.text: The daughter of Egypt will certainly feel shame. She will actually be given into the hand of the people of the north.’

20186.label: Jeremiah 46:25
20186.text: “Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Here I am turning my attention upon Aʹmon from No and upon Pharʹaoh and upon Egypt and upon her gods and upon her kings, even upon Pharʹaoh and upon all those trusting in him.’

20187.label: Jeremiah 46:26
20187.text: “‘And I will give them into the hand of those seeking for their soul and into the hand of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon and into the hand of his servants; and afterward she will be resided in as in the days of old,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20188.label: Jeremiah 46:27
20188.text: “‘And as for you, do not be afraid, O my servant Jacob, and do not be terror-stricken, O Israel. For here I am saving you from far away and your offspring from the land of their captivity. And Jacob will certainly return and have no disturbance and be at ease and without anyone causing trembling.

20189.label: Jeremiah 46:28
20189.text: As for you, do not be afraid, O my servant Jacob,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘for I am with you. For I shall make an extermination among all the nations to which I have dispersed you, but with you I shall make no extermination. Yet I shall have to chastise you to the proper degree, and I shall absolutely not leave you unpunished.’”

20190.label: Jeremiah 47:1
20190.text: This is what proved to be the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Phi·lisʹtines before Pharʹaoh proceeded to strike down Gaʹza.

20191.label: Jeremiah 47:2
20191.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Look! Waters are coming up from the north and have become a flooding torrent. And they will flood the land and what fills it, the city and those inhabiting it. And the men will certainly cry out, and everyone dwelling in the land must howl.

20192.label: Jeremiah 47:3
20192.text: At the sound of the stamping of the hoofs of his stallions, at the rattling of his war chariots, the turmoil of his wheels, the fathers will actually not turn around to the sons, because of the dropping down of [their] hands,

20193.label: Jeremiah 47:4
20193.text: on account of the day that is coming to despoil all the Phi·lisʹtines, to cut off from Tyre and from Siʹdon every survivor that was helping. For Jehovah is despoiling the Phi·lisʹtines, who are the remaining ones from the island of Caphʹtor.

20194.label: Jeremiah 47:5
20194.text: Baldness must come to Gaʹza. Ashʹke·lon has been put to silence. O remnant of their low plain, how long will you keep making cuts upon yourself?

20195.label: Jeremiah 47:6
20195.text: “Aha, the sword of Jehovah! How long will you not stay quiet? Be shoved into your sheath. Take your repose and keep silent.

20196.label: Jeremiah 47:7
20196.text: “How can it stay quiet, when Jehovah himself has given a command to it? It is for Ashʹke·lon and for the coast of the sea. There is where he has designated it to be.”

20197.label: Jeremiah 48:1
20197.text: For Moʹab this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “Woe to Neʹbo, for she has been despoiled! Kir·i·a·thaʹim has been put to shame, has been captured. The secure height has been put to shame and been put in terror.

20198.label: Jeremiah 48:2
20198.text: No more is there any praise of Moʹab. In Heshʹbon they have thought out against her a calamity: ‘Come, men, and let us cut her off from being a nation.’ “You, too, O Madʹmen, should keep silent. After you there walks a sword.

20199.label: Jeremiah 48:3
20199.text: There is the sound of an outcry from Hor·o·naʹim, a despoiling and great breaking down.

20200.label: Jeremiah 48:4
20200.text: Moʹab has been broken down. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

20201.label: Jeremiah 48:5
20201.text: For on the way up to Luʹhith it is with weeping that one goes up—there is a weeping. For on the way down from Hor·o·naʹim there is a distressing outcry over the breakdown that people have heard.

20202.label: Jeremiah 48:6
20202.text: “Take to flight; provide escape for YOUR souls, and YOU should become like a juniper tree in the wilderness.

20203.label: Jeremiah 48:7
20203.text: Because your trust is in your works and in your treasures, you yourself will also be captured. And Cheʹmosh will certainly go forth into exile, his priests and his princes at the same time.

20204.label: Jeremiah 48:8
20204.text: And the despoiler will come in on every city, and there will be no city that can make its escape. And the low plain will certainly perish and the level land be annihilated, a thing that Jehovah has said.

20205.label: Jeremiah 48:9
20205.text: “Give a road mark to Moʹab, YOU people, for at the falling in ruins she will go forth; and her very cities will become a mere object of astonishment, with no one dwelling in them.

20206.label: Jeremiah 48:10
20206.text: “Cursed be the one that is carrying out the mission of Jehovah neglectfully; and cursed be the one that is holding back his sword from blood!

20207.label: Jeremiah 48:11
20207.text: “The Moʹab·ites have been at ease since their youth, and they are keeping undisturbed on their dregs. And they have not been emptied from one vessel into another vessel, and into exile they have not gone. That is why their taste has stood still within them, and their very scent has not been changed.

20208.label: Jeremiah 48:12
20208.text: “‘Therefore, look! there are days coming,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I will send to them [vessel] tilters, and they will certainly tilt them; and their vessels they will empty out, and their large jars they will dash to pieces.

20209.label: Jeremiah 48:13
20209.text: And the Moʹab·ites will have to be ashamed of Cheʹmosh, just as those of the house of Israel have become ashamed of Bethʹel their confidence.

20210.label: Jeremiah 48:14
20210.text: How dare YOU people say: “We are mighty men and men of vital energy for the war”?’

20211.label: Jeremiah 48:15
20211.text: “‘Moʹab has been despoiled, and one has gone up against her own cities. And their choicest young men themselves have gone down to the slaughtering,’ is the utterance of the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies.

20212.label: Jeremiah 48:16
20212.text: “The disaster on the Moʹab·ites is near to come, and their very calamity is actually hurrying up very much.

20213.label: Jeremiah 48:17
20213.text: All those round about them will have to sympathize with them, even all those knowing their name. Say, YOU people, ‘O how the rod of strength has been broken, the staff of beauty!’

20214.label: Jeremiah 48:18
20214.text: “Get down from glory, and sit down in thirst, O inhabitress of the daughter of Diʹbon; for the despoiler of Moʹab has come up against you. He will actually bring your fortified places to ruin.

20215.label: Jeremiah 48:19
20215.text: “Stand still and look out for the way itself, O inhabitress of A·roʹer. Ask him that is fleeing and her that is making her escape. Say, ‘What has been brought about?’

20216.label: Jeremiah 48:20
20216.text: Moʹab has been put to shame, for she has been struck with terror. Howl and cry out. Tell in Arʹnon, O men, that Moʹab has been despoiled.

20217.label: Jeremiah 48:21
20217.text: And judgment itself has come to the land of level country, to Hoʹlon and to Jaʹhaz and against Mephʹa·ath,

20218.label: Jeremiah 48:22
20218.text: and against Diʹbon and against Neʹbo and against Beth-dib·la·thaʹim,

20219.label: Jeremiah 48:23
20219.text: and against Kir·i·a·thaʹim and against Beth-gaʹmul and against Beth-meʹon

20220.label: Jeremiah 48:24
20220.text: and against Keʹri·oth and against Bozʹrah and against all the cities of the land of Moʹab, those far away and those near.

20221.label: Jeremiah 48:25
20221.text: “‘The horn of Moʹab has been cut down, and his own arm has been broken,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20222.label: Jeremiah 48:26
20222.text: ‘Make him drunk, O men, for he has put on great airs against Jehovah himself; and Moʹab has slapped around in his vomit, and he has become an object of ridicule, even he himself.

20223.label: Jeremiah 48:27
20223.text: “‘And did not Israel become a mere object of ridicule to you? Or was he found among outright thieves? For you would shake yourself just as often as you spoke against him.

20224.label: Jeremiah 48:28
20224.text: “‘Leave the cities and reside on the crag, YOU inhabitants of Moʹab, and become like the dove that makes its nest in the regions of the mouth of the hollow.’”

20225.label: Jeremiah 48:29
20225.text: “We have heard of the pride of Moʹab —he is very haughty—of his highness and of his pride and of his haughtiness and of the loftiness of his heart.”

20226.label: Jeremiah 48:30
20226.text: “‘I myself have known his fury,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and that is not the way it will be; his empty talk —they will not actually do in just that way.

20227.label: Jeremiah 48:31
20227.text: That is why it is over Moʹab that I shall howl, and for Moʹab in his entirety I shall cry out. For the men of Kir-heʹres one shall moan.

20228.label: Jeremiah 48:32
20228.text: “‘With more than the weeping for Jaʹzer I shall weep for you, O vine of Sibʹmah. Your own flourishing shoots have crossed over the sea. To the sea—[to] Jaʹzer —they have reached. Upon your summer fruitage and upon your grape gathering the despoiler himself has fallen.

20229.label: Jeremiah 48:33
20229.text: And rejoicing and joyfulness have been taken away from the orchard and from the land of Moʹab. And from the winepresses I have caused the wine itself to cease. No one will be doing the treading with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.’”

20230.label: Jeremiah 48:34
20230.text: “‘From the cry in Heshʹbon clear to E·le·aʹleh, clear to Jaʹhaz they have given forth their voice, from Zoʹar clear to Hor·o·naʹim, to Egʹlath-she·liʹshi·yah; for even the waters of Nimʹrim themselves will become mere desolations.

20231.label: Jeremiah 48:35
20231.text: And I will cause to cease from Moʹab,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘the one bringing up an offering upon the high place and the one making sacrificial smoke to his god.

20232.label: Jeremiah 48:36
20232.text: That is why my own heart will be boisterous for Moʹab himself, just like flutes; and for the men of Kir-heʹres my very heart will be boisterous, just like flutes. That is why the very abundance that he has produced will certainly perish.

20233.label: Jeremiah 48:37
20233.text: For upon every head there is baldness, and every beard is clipped. Upon all hands there are cuts, and upon the hips there is sackcloth!’”

20234.label: Jeremiah 48:38
20234.text: “‘On all the roofs of Moʹab and in her public squares—all of it—there is wailing; for I have broken Moʹab just like a vessel in which there is no delight,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20235.label: Jeremiah 48:39
20235.text: ‘O how she has become terrified! Howl, YOU people! O how Moʹab has turned the back! He has become ashamed. And Moʹab has become an object of ridicule and something terrifying to all those round about him.’”

20236.label: Jeremiah 48:40
20236.text: “For this is what Jehovah has said, ‘Look! Just like an eagle that pounces, someone must also spread his wings over Moʹab.

20237.label: Jeremiah 48:41
20237.text: The towns will actually be captured, and her own strong places will certainly be seized. And the heart of the mighty men of Moʹab must become in that day like the heart of a wife having childbirth distress.’”

20238.label: Jeremiah 48:42
20238.text: “‘And Moʹab will certainly be annihilated from being a people, for it is against Jehovah that he has put on great airs.

20239.label: Jeremiah 48:43
20239.text: Dread and the hollow and the trap are upon you, O inhabitant of Moʹab,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20240.label: Jeremiah 48:44
20240.text: ‘Anyone fleeing because of the dread will fall into the hollow; and anyone coming up out of the hollow will be caught in the trap.’ “‘For I shall bring upon her, upon Moʹab, the year of their being given attention,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.

20241.label: Jeremiah 48:45
20241.text: ‘In the shadow of Heshʹbon those fleeing have stood still without power. For a very fire will certainly go forth out of Heshʹbon, and a flame from the midst of Siʹhon; and it will devour the temples of Moʹab and the crown of the head of the sons of uproar.’

20242.label: Jeremiah 48:46
20242.text: “‘Woe to you, O Moʹab! The people of Cheʹmosh have perished. For your sons have been taken as captives and your daughters as captives.

20243.label: Jeremiah 48:47
20243.text: And I will gather the captive ones of Moʹab in the final part of the days,’ is the utterance of Jehovah. ‘Down to this point is the judgment upon Moʹab.’”

20244.label: Jeremiah 49:1
20244.text: For the sons of Amʹmon this is what Jehovah has said: “Are there no sons that Israel has, or is there no inheritor that he has? Why is it that Malʹcam has taken possession of Gad, and his own people have taken up dwelling in [Israel’s] very cities?”

20245.label: Jeremiah 49:2
20245.text: “‘Therefore, look! there are days coming,’ is the utterance of Jehovah, ‘and I will cause the alarm signal of war to be heard even against Rabʹbah of the sons of Amʹmon; and she will certainly become a mound of a desolate waste, and her dependent towns themselves will be set aflame in the very fire.’ “‘And Israel will actually take possession of those in possession of him,’ Jehovah has said.

20246.label: Jeremiah 49:3
20246.text: “‘Howl, O Heshʹbon, for Aʹi has been despoiled! Cry out, O dependent towns of Rabʹbah. Gird sackcloth on yourselves. Wail, and rove about among the stone pens, for Malʹcam himself will go even into exile, his priests and his princes, all together.

20247.label: Jeremiah 49:4
20247.text: Why do you brag about the low plains, your flowing low plain, O daughter unfaithful, you the one trusting in her treasures, [saying:] “Who will come to me?”’”

20248.label: Jeremiah 49:5
20248.text: “‘Here I am bringing in upon you a dreadful thing,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, ‘from all those round about you. And YOU people will certainly be dispersed, each one in his own direction, and there will be no one collecting together those running away.’”

20249.label: Jeremiah 49:6
20249.text: “‘But afterward I shall gather the captive ones of the sons of Amʹmon,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

20250.label: Jeremiah 49:7
20250.text: For Eʹdom this is what Jehovah of armies has said: “Is there no longer any wisdom in Teʹman? Has counsel perished from those having understanding? Has their wisdom gone to putrefying?

20251.label: Jeremiah 49:8
20251.text: Flee! Let yourselves give way! Go down deep in order to dwell, O inhabitants of Deʹdan! For the disaster of Eʹsau I will bring in upon him, the time that I must turn my attention to him.

20252.label: Jeremiah 49:9
20252.text: If grape gatherers themselves actually came in to you, would they not let some gleanings remain? If thieves [came in] by night, they would certainly cause only as much ruin as they wanted.

20253.label: Jeremiah 49:10
20253.text: But as for me, I will strip Eʹsau bare. I will uncover his places of concealment, and one will not be able to hide oneself. His offspring and his brothers and his neighbors will certainly be despoiled, and he will not be.

20254.label: Jeremiah 49:11
20254.text: Do leave your fatherless boys. I myself shall preserve [them] alive, and your own widows will trust even in me.”

20255.label: Jeremiah 49:12
20255.text: For this is what Jehovah has said: “Look! Although it is not their custom to drink the cup, they will drink without fail. And you yourself, will you be absolutely left unpunished? You will not be left unpunished, for you will drink without fail.”

20256.label: Jeremiah 49:13
20256.text: “For by my own self I have sworn,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “that nothing but an object of astonishment, a reproach, a devastation and a malediction will Bozʹrah become; and all her own cities will become devastated places to time indefinite.”

20257.label: Jeremiah 49:14
20257.text: There is a report that I have heard from Jehovah, and there is an envoy that is sent among the nations, [saying:] “Collect yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to battle.”

20258.label: Jeremiah 49:15
20258.text: “For, look! I have made you small indeed among the nations, despised among mankind.

20259.label: Jeremiah 49:16
20259.text: The shuddering you caused has deceived you, the presumptuousness of your heart, O you who are residing in the retreats of the crag, holding the height of the hill. Although you build your nest high up just like an eagle, down from there I shall bring you,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20260.label: Jeremiah 49:17
20260.text: “And Eʹdom must become an object of astonishment. Everyone passing along by her will stare in astonishment and whistle on account of all her plagues.

20261.label: Jeremiah 49:18
20261.text: Just as in the overthrow of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah and her neighbor [towns],” Jehovah has said, “no man will dwell there, and no son of mankind will reside in her as an alien.

20262.label: Jeremiah 49:19
20262.text: “Look! Someone will come up just like a lion from the proud [thickets] along the Jordan to the durable abiding place, but in a moment I will make him run away from her. And the one who is chosen I shall appoint over her. For who is like me, and who will challenge me, and who, now, is the shepherd that can stand before me?

20263.label: Jeremiah 49:20
20263.text: Therefore hear, O men, the counsel of Jehovah that he has formulated against Eʹdom, and his thoughts that he has thought out against the inhabitants of Teʹman: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged about. Surely on account of them he will make their dwelling place become desolate.

20264.label: Jeremiah 49:21
20264.text: At the sound of their falling the earth has begun to rock. There is an outcry! The sound of it has been heard even at the Red Sea.

20265.label: Jeremiah 49:22
20265.text: Look! Just like an eagle someone will ascend and pounce down, and he will spread out his wings over Bozʹrah; and the heart of the mighty men of Eʹdom will actually become in that day like the heart of the wife having distress in childbirth.”

20266.label: Jeremiah 49:23
20266.text: For Damascus: “Haʹmath and Arʹpad have become ashamed, for it is a bad report that they have heard. They have disintegrated. In the sea there is anxious care; it is not able to keep undisturbed.

20267.label: Jeremiah 49:24
20267.text: Damascus has lost courage. She has turned to flee, and sheer panic has seized her. Distress and birth pangs themselves have taken hold of her, as with a woman that is giving birth.

20268.label: Jeremiah 49:25
20268.text: How is it that the city of praise has not been abandoned, the town of exultation?

20269.label: Jeremiah 49:26
20269.text: “Therefore her young men will fall in her public squares, and all the men of war themselves will be brought to silence in that day,” is the utterance of Jehovah of armies.

20270.label: Jeremiah 49:27
20270.text: “And I will set a fire ablaze on the wall of Damascus, and it will certainly devour the dwelling towers of Ben-haʹdad.”

20271.label: Jeremiah 49:28
20271.text: For Keʹdar and the kingdoms of Haʹzor, which Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon struck down, this is what Jehovah has said: “Rise up, go up to Keʹdar, O men, and despoil the sons of the East.

20272.label: Jeremiah 49:29
20272.text: Their own tents and their own flocks will be taken, their tent cloths and all their articles. And their own camels will be carried off from them. And they will certainly cry out to them, ‘Fright is all around!’”

20273.label: Jeremiah 49:30
20273.text: “Flee, take flight far away; go down deep in order to dwell, O inhabitants of Haʹzor,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “For Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon has formulated a counsel even against YOU and has thought out against YOU a thought.”

20274.label: Jeremiah 49:31
20274.text: “Rise up, O men, go up against the nation that is at ease, dwelling in security!” is the utterance of Jehovah. “No doors and no bar does it have. Solitary they reside.

20275.label: Jeremiah 49:32
20275.text: And their camels must become a plunder, and the multitude of their livestock a spoil. And I will scatter them to every wind, those who have their hair clipped at the temples; and from all regions near it I shall bring in their disaster,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20276.label: Jeremiah 49:33
20276.text: “And Haʹzor must become the lair of jackals, a desolate waste to time indefinite. No man will dwell there, and in her no son of mankind will reside as an alien.”

20277.label: Jeremiah 49:34
20277.text: This is what occurred as the word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Eʹlam in the beginning of the kingship of Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah, saying:

20278.label: Jeremiah 49:35
20278.text: “This is what Jehovah of armies has said, ‘Here I am breaking the bow of Eʹlam, the beginning of their mightiness.

20279.label: Jeremiah 49:36
20279.text: And I will bring in upon Eʹlam the four winds from the four extremities of the heavens. And I will scatter them to all these winds, and there will prove to be no nation to which the dispersed ones of Eʹlam will not come.’”

20280.label: Jeremiah 49:37
20280.text: “And I will shatter the Eʹlam·ites before their enemies and before those seeking for their soul; and I will bring upon them a calamity, my burning anger,” is the utterance of Jehovah. “And I will send after them the sword until I shall have exterminated them.”

20281.label: Jeremiah 49:38
20281.text: “And I will set my throne in Eʹlam, and I will destroy out of there the king and the princes,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20282.label: Jeremiah 49:39
20282.text: “And it will certainly occur in the final part of the days that I shall gather the captive ones of Eʹlam,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20283.label: Jeremiah 50:1
20283.text: The word that Jehovah spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chal·deʹans, by means of Jeremiah the prophet:

20284.label: Jeremiah 50:2
20284.text: “Tell [it] among the nations and publish [it]. And lift up a signal; publish [it]. Hide nothing, O men. Say, ‘Babylon has been captured. Bel has been put to shame. Merʹo·dach has become terrified. Her images have been put to shame. Her dungy idols have become terrified.’

20285.label: Jeremiah 50:3
20285.text: For against her a nation has come up from the north. It is the one that makes her land an object of astonishment, so that there proves to be no one dwelling in her. Both man and domestic animal have taken flight. They have gone away.”

20286.label: Jeremiah 50:4
20286.text: “In those days and at that time,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “the sons of Israel, they and the sons of Judah together, will come. They will walk, weeping as they walk, and for Jehovah their God they will seek.

20287.label: Jeremiah 50:5
20287.text: To Zion they will keep asking the way, with their faces in that direction, [saying,] ‘Come and let us join ourselves to Jehovah in an indefinitely lasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

20288.label: Jeremiah 50:6
20288.text: A flock of perishing creatures my people has become. Their own shepherds have caused them to wander about. On the mountains they have led them away. From mountain to hill they have gone. They have forgotten their resting-place.

20289.label: Jeremiah 50:7
20289.text: All those finding them have eaten them up, and their own adversaries have said, ‘We shall not become guilty, due to the fact that they have sinned against Jehovah the abiding place of righteousness and the hope of their forefathers, Jehovah.’”

20290.label: Jeremiah 50:8
20290.text: “Take YOUR flight out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth even out of the land of the Chal·deʹans, and become like the leading animals before the flock.

20291.label: Jeremiah 50:9
20291.text: For here I am arousing and bringing up against Babylon a congregation of great nations from the land of the north, and they will certainly array themselves against her. From there she will be captured. One’s arrows are like those of a mighty man causing bereavement of children, who does not come back without results.

20292.label: Jeremiah 50:10
20292.text: And Chal·deʹa must become a spoil. All those making spoil of her will satisfy themselves,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20293.label: Jeremiah 50:11
20293.text: “For YOU men kept rejoicing, for YOU men kept exulting when pillaging my own inheritance. For YOU kept pawing like a heifer in the tender grass, and YOU kept neighing like stallions.

20294.label: Jeremiah 50:12
20294.text: The mother of YOU men has become very much ashamed. She that gave YOU birth has been disappointed. Look! She is the least important of the nations, a waterless wilderness and a desert plain.

20295.label: Jeremiah 50:13
20295.text: Because of the indignation of Jehovah she will not be inhabited, and she must become a desolate waste in her entirety. As for anyone passing along by Babylon, he will stare in astonishment and whistle on account of all her plagues.

20296.label: Jeremiah 50:14
20296.text: “Array yourselves against Babylon on every side, all YOU who are treading the bow. Shoot at her. Spare no arrow, for it is against Jehovah that she has sinned.

20297.label: Jeremiah 50:15
20297.text: Shout a war cry against her on every side. She has given her hand. Her pillars have fallen. Her walls have been torn down. For it is the vengeance of Jehovah. Take YOUR vengeance on her. Just as she has done, do to her.

20298.label: Jeremiah 50:16
20298.text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one handling the sickle in the time of harvest. Because of the maltreating sword they will turn each one to his own people, and they will flee each one to his own land.

20299.label: Jeremiah 50:17
20299.text: “Israel is a scattered sheep. Lions themselves have done the dispersing. In the first instance the king of As·syrʹi·a has devoured him, and in this latter instance Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon has gnawed on his bones.

20300.label: Jeremiah 50:18
20300.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said, ‘Here I am turning my attention upon the king of Babylon and upon his land in the same way that I turned my attention upon the king of As·syrʹi·a.

20301.label: Jeremiah 50:19
20301.text: And I will bring Israel back to his pasture ground, and he will certainly graze on Carʹmel and on Baʹshan; and in the mountainous region of Eʹphra·im and of Gilʹe·ad his soul will be satisfied.’”

20302.label: Jeremiah 50:20
20302.text: “And in those days and at that time,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “the error of Israel will be searched for, but it will not be; and the sins of Judah, and they will not be found, for I shall forgive those whom I let remain.”

20303.label: Jeremiah 50:21
20303.text: “Against the land of Mer·a·thaʹim —come up against her and against the inhabitants of Peʹkod. Let there be a massacre and a devoting to destruction close upon them,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.

20304.label: Jeremiah 50:22
20304.text: There is the sound of war in the land, and a great breakdown.

20305.label: Jeremiah 50:23
20305.text: O how the forge hammer of all the earth has been cut down and gets broken! O how Babylon has become a mere object of astonishment among the nations!

20306.label: Jeremiah 50:24
20306.text: I have laid a snare for you and you have also been caught, O Babylon, and you yourself did not know [it]. You were found and also taken hold of, for it was against Jehovah that you excited yourself.

20307.label: Jeremiah 50:25
20307.text: “Jehovah has opened his storehouse, and he brings forth the weapons of his denunciation. For there is a work that the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, has in the land of the Chal·deʹans.

20308.label: Jeremiah 50:26
20308.text: Come in to her from the farthest part. Open up her granaries. Bank her up, just like those making heaps, and devote her to destruction. May she not come to have any remaining ones.

20309.label: Jeremiah 50:27
20309.text: Massacre all her young bulls. May they go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time for their being given attention!

20310.label: Jeremiah 50:28
20310.text: “There is the sound of those fleeing and those escaping from the land of Babylon to tell out in Zion the vengeance of Jehovah our God, the vengeance for his temple.

20311.label: Jeremiah 50:29
20311.text: “SUMMON against Babylon archers, all who are treading the bow. Encamp against her all around. May there prove to be no escapees. Pay back to her according to her activity. According to all that she has done, do to her. For it is against Jehovah that she has acted presumptuously, against the Holy One of Israel.

20312.label: Jeremiah 50:30
20312.text: Therefore her young men will fall in her public squares, and even all her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20313.label: Jeremiah 50:31
20313.text: “Look! I am against you, O Presumptuousness,” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies, “for your day must come, the time that I must give you attention.

20314.label: Jeremiah 50:32
20314.text: And Presumptuousness will certainly stumble and fall, and it will have no one to cause it to rise up. And I will set a fire ablaze in its cities, and it must devour all its surroundings.”

20315.label: Jeremiah 50:33
20315.text: This is what Jehovah of armies has said: “The sons of Israel and the sons of Judah are being oppressed together, and all those taking them captive have laid hold on them. They have refused to let them go.

20316.label: Jeremiah 50:34
20316.text: Their Repurchaser is strong, Jehovah of armies being his name. Without fail he will conduct their legal case, in order that he may actually give repose to the land and cause agitation to the inhabitants of Babylon.”

20317.label: Jeremiah 50:35
20317.text: “There is a sword against the Chal·deʹans,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and against the inhabitants of Babylon and against her princes and against her wise ones.

20318.label: Jeremiah 50:36
20318.text: There is a sword against the empty talkers, and they will certainly act foolishly. There is a sword against her mighty men, and they will actually become terrified.

20319.label: Jeremiah 50:37
20319.text: There is a sword against their horses and against their war chariots and against all the mixed company that are in the midst of her, and they will certainly become women. There is a sword against her treasures, and they will actually be plundered.

20320.label: Jeremiah 50:38
20320.text: There is a devastation upon her waters, and they must be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and because of [their] frightful visions they keep acting crazy.

20321.label: Jeremiah 50:39
20321.text: Therefore the haunters of waterless regions will dwell with the howling animals, and in her the ostriches must dwell; and she will nevermore be dwelt in, nor will she reside for generation after generation.”

20322.label: Jeremiah 50:40
20322.text: “Just as with God’s overthrow of Sodʹom and of Go·morʹrah and of her neighbor [towns],” is the utterance of Jehovah, “no man will dwell there, nor will the son of mankind reside in her as an alien.

20323.label: Jeremiah 50:41
20323.text: “Look! A people is coming in from the north; and a great nation and grand kings themselves will be roused up from the remotest parts of the earth.

20324.label: Jeremiah 50:42
20324.text: Bow and javelin they handle. They are cruel and will show no mercy. The sound of them is like the sea that is boisterous, and upon horses they will ride; set in array as one man for war against you, O daughter of Babylon.

20325.label: Jeremiah 50:43
20325.text: “The king of Babylon has heard the report about them, and his hands have dropped down. There is distress! Severe pains have seized hold of him, just like a woman giving birth.

20326.label: Jeremiah 50:44
20326.text: “Look! Someone will come up just like a lion from the proud [thickets] along the Jordan to the durable abiding place, but in a moment I shall make them run away from her. And the one who is chosen I shall appoint over her. For who is like me, and who will challenge me, and who, now, is the shepherd that can stand before me?

20327.label: Jeremiah 50:45
20327.text: Therefore hear, O men, the counsel of Jehovah that he has formulated against Babylon and his thoughts that he has thought out against the land of the Chal·deʹans. Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged about. Surely on account of them he will cause their abiding place to be desolated.

20328.label: Jeremiah 50:46
20328.text: At the sound [when] Babylon has been seized, the earth will certainly be set rocking, and among the nations an outcry itself be heard.”

20329.label: Jeremiah 51:1
20329.text: This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am rousing up against Babylon and against the inhabitants of Leb-kaʹmai a ruinous wind;

20330.label: Jeremiah 51:2
20330.text: and I will send to Babylon winnowers who will certainly winnow her and who will make her land empty; for they will actually prove to be against her on all sides in the day of calamity.

20331.label: Jeremiah 51:3
20331.text: “Let the one treading his bow do no treading. And let no one raise himself up in his coat of mail. “And do not YOU men show any compassion for her young men. Devote to destruction all her army.

20332.label: Jeremiah 51:4
20332.text: And they must fall slain in the land of the Chal·deʹans and pierced through in her streets.

20333.label: Jeremiah 51:5
20333.text: “For Israel and Judah are not widowed from their God, from Jehovah of armies. For the land of those has been full of guilt from the standpoint of the Holy One of Israel.

20334.label: Jeremiah 51:6
20334.text: “FLEE out of the midst of Babylon, and provide escape each one for his own soul. Do not be rendered inanimate through her error. For it is the time of vengeance belonging to Jehovah. There is treatment that he is paying back to her.

20335.label: Jeremiah 51:7
20335.text: Babylon has been a golden cup in the hand of Jehovah, she making all the earth drunk. From her wine the nations have drunk. That is why the nations keep acting crazed.

20336.label: Jeremiah 51:8
20336.text: Suddenly Babylon has fallen, so that she is broken. Howl over her, YOU people. Take balsam for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.”

20337.label: Jeremiah 51:9
20337.text: “We would have healed Babylon, but she has not been healed. Leave her, YOU people, and let us go each one to his own land. For clear to the heavens her judgment has reached, and it has been lifted up to the cloudy skies.

20338.label: Jeremiah 51:10
20338.text: Jehovah has brought forth deeds of righteousness for us. Come and do let us recount in Zion the work of Jehovah our God.”

20339.label: Jeremiah 51:11
20339.text: “Polish the arrows. Fill the circular shields, O men. Jehovah has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because it is against Babylon that his idea is, in order to bring her to ruin. For it is the vengeance of Jehovah, the vengeance for his temple.

20340.label: Jeremiah 51:12
20340.text: Against the walls of Babylon lift up a signal. Make strong the watch. Post the watchmen. Make ready those lying in ambush. For Jehovah both has formed the idea and will certainly do what he has spoken against the inhabitants of Babylon.”

20341.label: Jeremiah 51:13
20341.text: “O woman residing on abounding waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your profit making.

20342.label: Jeremiah 51:14
20342.text: Jehovah of armies has sworn by his own soul, ‘I will fill you with men, like the locusts, and they will certainly sing forth over you a shout.’

20343.label: Jeremiah 51:15
20343.text: He is the Maker of the earth by his power, the One firmly establishing the productive land by his wisdom, and the One who by his understanding stretched out the heavens.

20344.label: Jeremiah 51:16
20344.text: At [his] voice there is a giving by him of a turmoil of waters in the heavens, and he causes vapors to ascend from the extremity of the earth. He has made even sluices for the rain, and he brings forth the wind from his storehouses.

20345.label: Jeremiah 51:17
20345.text: Every man has behaved so unreasoningly as not to know. Every metalworker will feel ashamed because of the carved image; for his molten image is a falsehood, and there is no spirit in them.

20346.label: Jeremiah 51:18
20346.text: They are vanity, a work of mockery. In the time of their being given attention they will perish.

20347.label: Jeremiah 51:19
20347.text: “The Share of Jacob is not like these things, for he is the Former of everything, even the staff of his inheritance. Jehovah of armies is his name.

20348.label: Jeremiah 51:20
20348.text: “You are a club for me, as weapons of war, and by you I shall certainly dash nations to pieces, and by you I will bring kingdoms to ruin.

20349.label: Jeremiah 51:21
20349.text: And by you I will dash the horse and his rider to pieces, and by you I will dash the war chariot and its rider to pieces.

20350.label: Jeremiah 51:22
20350.text: And by you I will dash man and woman to pieces, and by you I will dash old man and boy to pieces, and by you I will dash young man and virgin to pieces.

20351.label: Jeremiah 51:23
20351.text: And by you I will dash shepherd and his drove to pieces, and by you I will dash farmer and his span [of animals] to pieces, and by you I will dash governors and deputy rulers to pieces.

20352.label: Jeremiah 51:24
20352.text: And I will pay back to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chal·deʹa all their badness that they have committed in Zion before the eyes of YOU people,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20353.label: Jeremiah 51:25
20353.text: “Here I am against you, O ruinous mountain,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “you ruiner of the whole earth; and I will stretch out my hand against you and roll you away from the crags and make you a burnt-out mountain.”

20354.label: Jeremiah 51:26
20354.text: “And people will not take from you a stone for a corner or a stone for foundations, because desolate wastes to time indefinite are what you will become,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20355.label: Jeremiah 51:27
20355.text: “Lift up a signal in the land, O men. Blow a horn among the nations. Sanctify against her the nations. Summon against her the kingdoms of Arʹa·rat, Minʹni and Ashʹke·naz. Commission against her a recruiting officer. Make the horses come up like bristly locusts.

20356.label: Jeremiah 51:28
20356.text: Sanctify against her the nations, the kings of Meʹdi·a, its governors and all its deputy rulers and all the land of each one’s dominion.

20357.label: Jeremiah 51:29
20357.text: And let the earth rock and be in severe pain, for against Babylon the thoughts of Jehovah have risen up to make the land of Babylon an object of astonishment, without an inhabitant.

20358.label: Jeremiah 51:30
20358.text: “The mighty men of Babylon have ceased to fight. They have kept sitting in the strong places. Their mightiness has run dry. They have become women. Her residences have been set on fire. Her bars have been broken.

20359.label: Jeremiah 51:31
20359.text: “One runner runs to meet another runner, and one reporter to meet another reporter, to report to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured at every end,

20360.label: Jeremiah 51:32
20360.text: and that the fords themselves have been seized, and the papyrus boats they have burned with fire, and the men of war themselves have become disturbed.”

20361.label: Jeremiah 51:33
20361.text: For this is what Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, has said: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor. It is the time to tread her down solid. Yet a little while and the time of the harvest must come for her.”

20362.label: Jeremiah 51:34
20362.text: “Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon has eaten me up; he has thrown me into confusion. He has set me as an empty vessel. He has swallowed me down like a big snake; he has filled his abdomen with my pleasant things. He has rinsed me away.

20363.label: Jeremiah 51:35
20363.text: ‘The violence done to me and [to] my organism be upon Babylon!’ the inhabitress of Zion will say. ‘And my blood be upon the inhabitants of Chal·deʹa!’ Jerusalem will say.”

20364.label: Jeremiah 51:36
20364.text: Therefore this is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am conducting your legal case, and I shall certainly execute vengeance for you. And I will dry up her sea, and I will make her wells dry.

20365.label: Jeremiah 51:37
20365.text: And Babylon must become piles of stones, the lair of jackals, an object of astonishment and something to whistle at, without an inhabitant.

20366.label: Jeremiah 51:38
20366.text: All together they will roar just like maned young lions. They will certainly growl like the whelps of lions.”

20367.label: Jeremiah 51:39
20367.text: “When they are heated I shall set their banquets and I will make them drunk, in order that they may exult; and they must sleep an indefinitely lasting sleep, from which they will not wake up,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20368.label: Jeremiah 51:40
20368.text: “I shall bring them down like male sheep to the slaughtering, like rams along with the he-goats.”

20369.label: Jeremiah 51:41
20369.text: “O how Sheʹshach has been captured, and how the Praise of the whole earth gets to be seized! How Babylon has become a mere object of astonishment among the nations!

20370.label: Jeremiah 51:42
20370.text: The sea has come up even over Babylon. By the multitude of its waves she has been covered.

20371.label: Jeremiah 51:43
20371.text: Her cities have become an object of astonishment, a waterless land and a desert plain. As a land, in them no man will dwell, and through them no son of mankind will pass.

20372.label: Jeremiah 51:44
20372.text: And I will turn my attention upon Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth what he has swallowed. And to him nations will stream no more. Also, the wall itself of Babylon must fall.

20373.label: Jeremiah 51:45
20373.text: “Get out of the midst of her, O my people, and provide each one his soul with escape from the burning anger of Jehovah.

20374.label: Jeremiah 51:46
20374.text: Or otherwise YOUR heart will be timid, and YOU will become afraid because of the report that is to be heard in the land. And in one year the report will actually come, and after it in another year there will be the report and violence in the earth and ruler against ruler.

20375.label: Jeremiah 51:47
20375.text: Therefore, look! there are days coming, and I will turn my attention upon the graven images of Babylon; and all her own land will become ashamed, and all her own slain ones will fall in the midst of her.

20376.label: Jeremiah 51:48
20376.text: “And over Babylon the heavens and the earth and all that is in them will certainly cry out joyfully, for out of the north there will come to her the despoilers,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20377.label: Jeremiah 51:49
20377.text: “Not only was Babylon the cause for the slain ones of Israel to fall but also at Babylon the slain ones of all the earth have fallen.

20378.label: Jeremiah 51:50
20378.text: “YOU escapees from the sword, keep going. Do not stand still. From far away remember Jehovah, and may Jerusalem herself come up into YOUR heart.”

20379.label: Jeremiah 51:51
20379.text: “We have been put to shame, for we have heard reproach. Humiliation has covered our faces, for strangers have come against the holy places of the house of Jehovah.”

20380.label: Jeremiah 51:52
20380.text: “Therefore, look! there are days coming,” is the utterance of Jehovah, “and I will turn my attention upon her graven images, and throughout all her land the pierced one will groan.”

20381.label: Jeremiah 51:53
20381.text: “Even if Babylon should ascend to the heavens and even if she should make the height of her strength unapproachable, from me the despoilers will come to her,” is the utterance of Jehovah.

20382.label: Jeremiah 51:54
20382.text: “Listen! There is an outcry from Babylon, and a great crash from the land of the Chal·deʹans,

20383.label: Jeremiah 51:55
20383.text: for Jehovah is despoiling Babylon, and he will certainly destroy out of her the great voice, and their waves will actually be boisterous like many waters. The noise of their voice will certainly be given out.

20384.label: Jeremiah 51:56
20384.text: For there must come upon her, upon Babylon, the despoiler, and her mighty men will certainly be captured. Their bows must be shattered, for Jehovah is a God of recompenses. Without fail he will repay.

20385.label: Jeremiah 51:57
20385.text: And I will make her princes and her wise ones, her governors and her deputy rulers and her mighty men drunk, and they must sleep an indefinitely lasting sleep, from which they will not wake up,” is the utterance of the King, whose name is Jehovah of armies.

20386.label: Jeremiah 51:58
20386.text: This is what Jehovah of armies has said: “The wall of Babylon, although broad, will without fail be demolished; and her gates, although high, will be set aflame with fire. And the peoples will have to toil for simply nothing, and national groups simply for the fire; and they will just tire themselves out.”

20387.label: Jeremiah 51:59
20387.text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet commanded Se·raiʹah the son of Ne·riʹah the son of Mah·seiʹah when he went with Zed·e·kiʹah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his being king; and Se·raiʹah was the quartermaster.

20388.label: Jeremiah 51:60
20388.text: And Jeremiah proceeded to write in one book all the calamity that would come upon Babylon, even all these words written against Babylon.

20389.label: Jeremiah 51:61
20389.text: Furthermore, Jeremiah said to Se·raiʹah: “As soon as you come to Babylon and actually see [her], you must also read aloud all these words.

20390.label: Jeremiah 51:62
20390.text: And you must say, ‘O Jehovah, you yourself have spoken against this place, in order to cut it off so that there may come to be in it no inhabitant, either man or even domestic animal, but that she may become mere desolate wastes to time indefinite.’

20391.label: Jeremiah 51:63
20391.text: And it must occur that when you will have completed reading this book, you will tie to it a stone, and you must pitch it into the midst of the Eu·phraʹtes.

20392.label: Jeremiah 51:64
20392.text: And you must say, ‘This is how Babylon will sink down and never rise up because of the calamity that I am bringing in upon her; and they will certainly tire themselves out.’” Down to this point are the words of Jeremiah.

20393.label: Jeremiah 52:1
20393.text: Zed·e·kiʹah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and for eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Ha·muʹtal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libʹnah.

20394.label: Jeremiah 52:2
20394.text: And he continued to do what was bad in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that Je·hoiʹa·kim had done.

20395.label: Jeremiah 52:3
20395.text: For on account of the anger of Jehovah it occurred in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from before his face. And Zed·e·kiʹah proceeded to rebel against the king of Babylon.

20396.label: Jeremiah 52:4
20396.text: Finally it came about in the ninth year of his being king, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, that Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon came, he and all his military force, against Jerusalem, and they began to camp against her and to build against her a siege wall all around.

20397.label: Jeremiah 52:5
20397.text: So the city came under siege until the eleventh year of King Zed·e·kiʹah.

20398.label: Jeremiah 52:6
20398.text: In the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the famine also got to be severe in the city and there proved to be no bread for the people of the land.

20399.label: Jeremiah 52:7
20399.text: Finally the city was broken through; and as regards all the men of war, they began to run away and go forth from the city by night by the way of the gate between the double wall that is by the king’s garden, while the Chal·deʹans were all around against the city; and they kept going by the way of the Arʹa·bah.

20400.label: Jeremiah 52:8
20400.text: And a military force of the Chal·deʹans went chasing after the king, and they got to overtake Zed·e·kiʹah in the desert plains of Jerʹi·cho; and all his own military force was scattered from his side.

20401.label: Jeremiah 52:9
20401.text: Then they seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath, that he might pronounce upon him judicial decisions.

20402.label: Jeremiah 52:10
20402.text: And the king of Babylon proceeded to slaughter the sons of Zed·e·kiʹah before his eyes, and also all the princes of Judah he slaughtered in Ribʹlah.

20403.label: Jeremiah 52:11
20403.text: And the eyes of Zed·e·kiʹah he blinded, after which the king of Babylon bound him with copper fetters and brought him to Babylon and put him in the house of custody until the day of his death.

20404.label: Jeremiah 52:12
20404.text: And in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that is, [in] the nineteenth year of King Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar, the king of Babylon, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard, who was standing before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

20405.label: Jeremiah 52:13
20405.text: And he proceeded to burn the house of Jehovah and the house of the king and all the houses of Jerusalem; and every great house he burned with fire.

20406.label: Jeremiah 52:14
20406.text: And all the walls of Jerusalem, round about, all the military forces of the Chal·deʹans that were with the chief of the bodyguard pulled down.

20407.label: Jeremiah 52:15
20407.text: And some of the lowly ones of the people and the rest of the people that were left remaining in the city and the deserters that had fallen away to the king of Babylon and the rest of the master workmen Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard took into exile.

20408.label: Jeremiah 52:16
20408.text: And some of the lowly ones of the land Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard let remain as vinedressers and as compulsory laborers.

20409.label: Jeremiah 52:17
20409.text: And the copper pillars that belonged to the house of Jehovah and the carriages and the copper sea that was in the house of Jehovah the Chal·deʹans broke to pieces and went carrying all the copper of them to Babylon.

20410.label: Jeremiah 52:18
20410.text: And the cans and the shovels and the extinguishers and the bowls and the cups and all the copper utensils with which they used to minister they took.

20411.label: Jeremiah 52:19
20411.text: And the basins and the fire holders and the bowls and the cans and the lampstands and the cups and the bowls that were of genuine gold, and those that were of genuine silver, the chief of the bodyguard took.

20412.label: Jeremiah 52:20
20412.text: And the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve copper bulls that were under [the sea], the carriages, that King Solʹo·mon had made for the house of Jehovah. There happened to be no weight [taken] of the copper of them—all these articles.

20413.label: Jeremiah 52:21
20413.text: And as regards the pillars, eighteen cubits in height was each pillar, and a thread of twelve cubits itself would go around it; and its thickness was four fingerbreadths, it being hollow.

20414.label: Jeremiah 52:22
20414.text: And the capital upon it was of copper, and the height of the one capital was five cubits; and as regards the network and the pomegranates upon the capital, all around, the whole was of copper; and the second pillar had just the same as these, also the pomegranates.

20415.label: Jeremiah 52:23
20415.text: And the pomegranates came to be ninety-six, on the sides, all the pomegranates being one hundred upon the network round about.

20416.label: Jeremiah 52:24
20416.text: Furthermore, the chief of the bodyguard took Se·raiʹah the chief priest and Zeph·a·niʹah the second priest and the three doorkeepers,

20417.label: Jeremiah 52:25
20417.text: and from the city he took one court official that happened to be commissioner over the men of war, and seven men of those having access to the king, who were found in the city, and the secretary of the chief of the army, the one mustering the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the midst of the city.

20418.label: Jeremiah 52:26
20418.text: So these Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard took and conducted them to the king of Babylon at Ribʹlah.

20419.label: Jeremiah 52:27
20419.text: And these the king of Babylon proceeded to strike down and to put them to death in Ribʹlah in the land of Haʹmath. Thus Judah went into exile from off its soil.

20420.label: Jeremiah 52:28
20420.text: These are the people whom Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar took into exile: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews.

20421.label: Jeremiah 52:29
20421.text: In the eighteenth year of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar, from Jerusalem there were eight hundred and thirty-two souls.

20422.label: Jeremiah 52:30
20422.text: In the twenty-third year of Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar, Neb·uʹzar·adʹan the chief of the bodyguard took Jews into exile, seven hundred and forty-five souls. All the souls were four thousand and six hundred.

20423.label: Jeremiah 52:31
20423.text: At length it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Je·hoiʹa·chin the king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, that Eʹvil-merʹo·dach the king of Babylon, in the year of his becoming king, raised up the head of Je·hoiʹa·chin the king of Judah and proceeded to bring him forth from the prison house.

20424.label: Jeremiah 52:32
20424.text: And he began to speak with him good things and to put his throne higher than the thrones of the [other] kings that were with him in Babylon.

20425.label: Jeremiah 52:33
20425.text: And he took off his prison garments, and he ate bread before him constantly all the days of his life.

20426.label: Jeremiah 52:34
20426.text: And as for his allowance, there was a constant allowance given him from the king of Babylon, daily as due, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
